member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.AccumulationChartSubTitleStyle.Size
member.summary: Gets or sets the font size of the subtitle text in the Accumulation Chart.
member.value: A string representing the font size of the subtitle text. The default size is determined by the Accumulation Chart's theme. By default, the theme is set to with a subtitle text size of 14px.
member.remarks: This property accepts standard CSS font-size specifications, such as values in 'px'.

example.code: // The following code demonstrates setting a custom font size for the subtitle text: <SfAccumulationChart Title="Mobile Browser" SubTitle="Statistics"> <AccumulationChartSubTitleStyle Size="23px" /> <AccumulationChartSeriesCollection> <AccumulationChartSeries DataSource="@StatisticsDetails" XName="Browser" YName="Users"></AccumulationChartSeries> </AccumulationChartSeriesCollection> </SfAccumulationChart>

member.value: A string representing the font family of the subtitle text. The default font family is determined by the Accumulation Chart's theme. By default, the theme is set to with a subtitle font family of Helvetica.
member.remarks: This property accepts typical CSS font family names, allowing customization to match the desired text style.

example.code: // The following code demonstrates setting a custom font family for the subtitle text: <SfAccumulationChart Title="Mobile Browser" SubTitle="Statistics"> <AccumulationChartSubTitleStyle FontFamily="Arial" /> <AccumulationChartSeriesCollection> <AccumulationChartSeries DataSource="@StatisticsDetails" XName="Browser" YName="Users"></AccumulationChartSeries> </AccumulationChartSeriesCollection> </SfAccumulationChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.AccumulationChartSubTitleStyle.FontWeight
member.summary: Gets or sets the font weight of the subtitle text in the Accumulation Chart.
member.value: A string representing the font weight of the subtitle text. The default font weight is determined by the Accumulation Chart's theme. By default, the theme is set to with a subtitle font weight of 400.
member.remarks: The font weight can be a number (100 to 900), or a keyword such as 'normal', 'bold', 'bolder', or 'lighter'.

example.code: // The following code demonstrates setting a custom font weight for the subtitle text: <SfAccumulationChart Title="Mobile Browser" SubTitle="Statistics"> <AccumulationChartSubTitleStyle FontWeight="bold" /> <AccumulationChartSeriesCollection> <AccumulationChartSeries DataSource="@StatisticsDetails" XName="Browser" YName="Users"></AccumulationChartSeries> </AccumulationChartSeriesCollection> </SfAccumulationChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.AccumulationChartSubTitleStyle.TextAlignment
member.summary: Gets or sets the text alignment of the subtitle.
member.value:
One of the values that specifies the alignment of the text. Options include:
Near - Aligns the subtitle to the left end of the chart.
Far - Aligns the subtitle to the right end of the chart.
Center - Aligns the subtitle to the center of the chart.
The default value is Alignment.Center.
member.remarks: Text alignment adjusts the horizontal placement of text within its container, affecting its position relative to other content.

example.code: // The following code demonstrates setting the text alignment for the subtitle title: <SfAccumulationChart Title="Mobile Browser" SubTitle="Statistics"> <AccumulationChartSubTitleStyle TextAlignment="Alignment.Far" /> <AccumulationChartSeriesCollection> <AccumulationChartSeries DataSource="@StatisticsDetails" XName="Browser" YName="Users"></AccumulationChartSeries> </AccumulationChartSeriesCollection> </SfAccumulationChart>

member.summary: Sets and gets the content of the UI element.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.AccumulationChartLegendSettings.Alignment
member.summary: Gets or sets the alignment of the legend in an .
member.value:
One of the enumerations that specifies the legend alignment. Options include: - Near: Aligns the legend to the left or top based on the . - Center: Aligns the legend to the center of the chart. - Far: Aligns the legend to the right or bottom based on the .
The default value is Alignment.Center.
member.remarks: The alignment of the legend within the functions as follows: - Near: Aligns the legend to the top-left if is LegendPosition.Top and to the right-top if is LegendPosition.Right. - Center: Aligns the legend to the top center if is LegendPosition.Top and to the right center if is LegendPosition.Right. - Far: Aligns the legend to the top-right if is LegendPosition.Top and to the right-bottom if is LegendPosition.Right.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to set the legend alignment in an accumulation chart: <SfAccumulationChart> <AccumulationChartLegendSettings Visible="true" Alignment="Alignment.Far"></AccumulationChartLegendSettings> <AccumulationChartSeriesCollection> <AccumulationChartSeries DataSource="@StatisticsDetails" XName="Browser" YName="Users"></AccumulationChartSeries> </AccumulationChartSeriesCollection> </SfAccumulationChart>

member.value: A string value specifying the background color of the legend area. The default value is transparent.
member.remarks: The value can be specified in hex or rgba format, following valid CSS color string conventions.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to set the background color of the legend in an accumulation chart: <SfAccumulationChart> <AccumulationChartSeriesCollection> <AccumulationChartSeries DataSource="@StatisticsDetails" XName="Browser" YName="Users"></AccumulationChartSeries> </AccumulationChartSeriesCollection> <AccumulationChartLegendSettings Visible="true" Background="#4266f9"></AccumulationChartLegendSettings> </SfAccumulationChart>

member.remarks: If set to true, when hovered over the point element, the respective series will be highlighted using the property .

example.code: // The following code snippet demonstrates how to enable highlight in an Accumulation Chart: <SfAccumulationChart> <AccumulationChartSeriesCollection> <AccumulationChartSeries DataSource="@StatisticsDetails" XName="Browser" YName="Users"> </AccumulationChartSeries> </AccumulationChartSeriesCollection> <AccumulationChartTooltipSettings Enable="true" EnableHighlight="true"></AccumulationChartTooltipSettings> </SfAccumulationChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.AccumulationChartTooltipSettings.EnableMarker
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether to display a marker in the tooltip in the Accumulation Chart.
member.value: true if the marker should be displayed in the tooltip; otherwise, false. The default value is true.
member.remarks: If set to true, the marker shape assigned for the series associated with the hovered point is applied for the tooltip marker. If the marker is not enabled, a circle-shaped marker will be rendered by default.

example.code: // The following code snippet demonstrates how to configure an Accumulation Chart to disable the tooltip marker: <SfAccumulationChart> <AccumulationChartSeriesCollection> <AccumulationChartSeries DataSource="@StatisticsDetails" XName="Browser" YName="Users"> </AccumulationChartSeries> </AccumulationChartSeriesCollection> <AccumulationChartTooltipSettings Enable="true" EnableMarker="false"></AccumulationChartTooltipSettings> </SfAccumulationChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.AccumulationChartTooltipSettings.EnableTextWrap
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether to wrap the tooltip's long text based on the available space in the Accumulation Chart.
member.value: true if the tooltip text should be wrapped; otherwise, false. The default is typically false unless specified.
member.remarks: Using this property allows you to adjust the tooltip text to wrap automatically.

example.code: // This code snippet demonstrates how to enable text wrapping in the tooltip of an Accumulation Chart: <SfAccumulationChart> <AccumulationChartSeriesCollection> <AccumulationChartSeries DataSource="@StatisticsDetails" XName="Browser" YName="Users"> </AccumulationChartSeries> </AccumulationChartSeriesCollection> <AccumulationChartTooltipSettings Enable="true" EnableTextWrap="true"></AccumulationChartTooltipSettings> </SfAccumulationChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.AccumulationChartTooltipSettings.FadeOutDuration
member.summary: Gets or sets the duration for fading out the tooltip in the Accumulation Chart.
member.value: The fade-out duration in milliseconds. The default value is 1000.
member.remarks: This property specifies how long it takes for the tooltip to fade out after the user removes focus from the associated point in the chart.

example.code: // This code snippet demonstrates how to set a custom fade-out duration for the tooltip in an Accumulation Chart: <SfAccumulationChart> <AccumulationChartSeriesCollection> <AccumulationChartSeries DataSource="@StatisticsDetails" XName="Browser" YName="Users"> </AccumulationChartSeries> </AccumulationChartSeriesCollection> <AccumulationChartTooltipSettings Enable="true" FadeOutDuration="3000"></AccumulationChartTooltipSettings> </SfAccumulationChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.AccumulationChartTooltipSettings.Fill
member.summary: Gets or sets the fill color of the tooltip background in the Accumulation Chart.
member.value: A string representing the fill color of the tooltip background. The default fill color is determined by the Accumulation Chart's theme. By default, the theme is set to with a fill color of #020202.
member.remarks: The fill color accepts values in hex and rgba as a valid CSS color string.

example.code: // This example shows how to set a custom fill color for the tooltip of an Accumulation Chart: <SfAccumulationChart> <AccumulationChartSeriesCollection> <AccumulationChartSeries DataSource="@StatisticsDetails" XName="Browser" YName="Users"> </AccumulationChartSeries> </AccumulationChartSeriesCollection> <AccumulationChartTooltipSettings Enable="true" Fill="#d22253"></AccumulationChartTooltipSettings> </SfAccumulationChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.AccumulationChartTooltipSettings.Format
member.summary: Gets or sets the format for the tooltip content in the Accumulation Chart.
member.value: A string that defines the format for the tooltip content. The default value is an empty string.
member.remarks:
The property allows customization of the tooltip content. By default, the tooltip displays information for the x and y values of a point. Additional information can be included in the tooltip using a format string.
For example, the format "${point.x} : ${point.y}%" shows the point x value and a customized point y value in the tooltip.

example.code: // This example shows how to customize the tooltip format in an Accumulation Chart:

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.AccumulationChartTooltipSettings.Header
member.summary: Gets or sets the header text for the tooltip in the Accumulation Chart.
member.value: A string representing the tooltip header text. The default value is an empty string.
member.remarks: This property can provide additional context or information related to the data point being displayed. It allows you to set a custom header for the Accumulation Chart tooltip.

example.code: // This example shows how to set a custom header for the tooltip in an Accumulation Chart: <SfAccumulationChart> <AccumulationChartSeriesCollection> <AccumulationChartSeries DataSource="@StatisticsDetails" XName="Browser" YName="Users"> </AccumulationChartSeries> </AccumulationChartSeriesCollection> <AccumulationChartTooltipSettings Enable="true" Header="Sales"></AccumulationChartTooltipSettings> </SfAccumulationChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.AccumulationChartTooltipSettings.Opacity
member.summary: Gets or sets the opacity of the tooltip in the Accumulation Chart.
member.value: A double value specifying the opacity of the tooltip. It ranges from 0 to 1. The default value is 0.75.
member.remarks: Use this property to control the transparency of the tooltip.

example.code: // This example shows how to set the opacity of a tooltip to 0.5 in an Accumulation Chart: <SfAccumulationChart> <AccumulationChartSeriesCollection> <AccumulationChartSeries DataSource="@StatisticsDetails" XName="Browser" YName="Users"> </AccumulationChartSeries> </AccumulationChartSeriesCollection> <AccumulationChartTooltipSettings Enable="true" Opacity="0.5"></AccumulationChartTooltipSettings> </SfAccumulationChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.AccumulationChartTooltipSettings.Shared
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether a single tooltip will be displayed for every index in the Accumulation Chart.
member.value: A boolean value indicating whether tooltips are shared. If set to true, one tooltip will be shared across all series for the same index. The default value is false.
member.remarks: When shared tooltips are enabled, the header will default to displaying the x-value across series unless a custom header is provided.

example.code: // This example shows how to enable shared tooltips in an Accumulation Chart: <SfAccumulationChart> <AccumulationChartSeriesCollection> <AccumulationChartSeries DataSource="@StatisticsDetails" XName="Browser" YName="Users"/> </AccumulationChartSeriesCollection> <AccumulationChartTooltipSettings Enable="true" Shared="true"/> </SfAccumulationChart>

member.summary: Gets or sets a custom template to format the tooltip content in the Accumulation Chart.
member.value: A used to define the custom content template for the tooltip. Use ${x} and ${y} as placeholders to display the corresponding data point values.
member.remarks: Use this property to customize the appearance and content of the tooltip by defining a custom template. Use the template’s context parameter to access a and its fields

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.AccumulationChartTooltipSettings.TextStyle
member.summary: Gets or sets an instance of which controls the customization of the text style of the tooltip in the Accumulation Chart.
member.value: An instance of used to customize the text style in the tooltip.
member.remarks: Use this property to customize specific styling attributes such as color, font size, font weight, and font family for the text displayed in the tooltip.

example.code: // Example setting a custom font style for the tooltip text: <SfAccumulationChart> <AccumulationChartSeriesCollection> <AccumulationChartSeries DataSource="@StatisticsDetails" XName="Browser" YName="Users"></AccumulationChartSeries> </AccumulationChartSeriesCollection> <AccumulationChartTooltipSettings Enable="true"> <AccumulationChartTooltipTextStyle Size="16px" FontFamily="Arial" FontWeight="600" FontStyle="bold" Color="blue" Opacity=0.5/> </AccumulationChartTooltipSettings> </SfAccumulationChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.AccumulationChartTooltipTextStyle.Size
member.summary: Gets or sets the font size of the tooltip text in the Accumulation Chart.
member.value: A string representing the font size of the tooltip text. The default size is determined by the Accumulation Chart's theme. By default, the theme is set to with a tooltip text size of 13px.
member.remarks: This property accepts standard CSS font-size specifications, such as values in 'px'.

example.code: // Example setting a custom font size for the tooltip text: <SfAccumulationChart> <AccumulationChartSeriesCollection> <AccumulationChartSeries DataSource="@StatisticsDetails" XName="Browser" YName="Users"></AccumulationChartSeries> </AccumulationChartSeriesCollection> <AccumulationChartTooltipSettings Enable="true"> <AccumulationChartTooltipTextStyle Size="16px" /> </AccumulationChartTooltipSettings> </SfAccumulationChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.AccumulationChartTooltipTextStyle.FontFamily
member.summary: Gets or sets the font family of the tooltip text in the Accumulation Chart.
member.value: A string representing the font family of the tooltip text. The default font family is determined by the Accumulation Chart's theme. By default, the theme is set to with tooltip font family Segoe UI.
member.remarks: The font family accepts typical CSS font family syntax, allowing customization to match the desired text style.

example.code: // Example setting a custom font family for the tooltip text: <SfAccumulationChart> <AccumulationChartSeriesCollection> <AccumulationChartSeries DataSource="@StatisticsDetails" XName="Browser" YName="Users"></AccumulationChartSeries> </AccumulationChartSeriesCollection> <AccumulationChartTooltipSettings Enable="true"> <AccumulationChartTooltipTextStyle FontFamily="Arial" /> </AccumulationChartTooltipSettings> </SfAccumulationChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.AccumulationChartTooltipTextStyle.FontWeight
member.summary: Gets or sets the font weight of the tooltip text in the Accumulation Chart.
member.value: A string representing the font weight of the tooltip text. The default font weight is determined by the Accumulation Chart's theme. By default, the theme is set to with a tooltip font weight of Normal.
member.remarks: The font weight can be a number (100 to 900), or a keyword such as 'normal', 'bold', 'bolder', or 'lighter'.

example.code: // Example setting a custom font weight for the tooltip text: <SfAccumulationChart> <AccumulationChartSeriesCollection> <AccumulationChartSeries DataSource="@StatisticsDetails" XName="Browser" YName="Users"></AccumulationChartSeries> </AccumulationChartSeriesCollection> <AccumulationChartTooltipSettings Enable="true"> <AccumulationChartTooltipTextStyle FontWeight="bold" /> </AccumulationChartTooltipSettings> </SfAccumulationChart>

member.summary: Represents an annotation, a user-defined HTML element that can be added to a chart. This class provides options for customizing these annotations to enhance their visual appeal.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAnnotation.ContentTemplate
member.summary: Gets or sets the content template for the annotation. The content template can be any HTML element, allowing for a flexible and customizable way to display additional information or visuals on the chart.
member.value: The template content is applied for the chart annotation based on the custom template provided by the user that is being rendered. The default value is null.
member.remarks: The is used to define a custom template for the chart annotation.

example.code:
// The following code snippet shows how to set up chart with custom annotation templates:
Annotation in Pixel
 ...

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAnnotation.CoordinateUnits
member.summary: Gets or sets the annotation’s coordinate units, either in Pixel or Point.
member.value:
One of the enumerations that specifies the coordinate units of an annotation. The options include: - Pixel: Annotation renders based on x and y pixel values. - Point: Annotation renders based on x and y axis values.
The default value is Units.Pixel.
member.remarks: Adjust the property to control how the annotation is positioned on the chart. Choosing Pixel makes the annotation placement more absolute relative to the control's boundaries, whereas Point allows it to respond dynamically to data changes and axis scaling.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAnnotation.Description
member.summary: Gets or sets information about the annotation for assistive technology.
member.value: A string providing additional details or context about the annotation that can be utilized by assistive technology.
member.remarks: Use the property to convey useful information to screen readers and other accessibility tools.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAnnotation.Region
member.summary: Gets or sets the regions to insert annotations in relation to a series or a chart.
member.value:
One of the enumerations that specifies the regions of an annotation. The options include: - Chart: Annotation renders based on chart coordinates. - Series: Annotation renders based on series coordinates.
The default value is Regions.Chart.
member.remarks: Adjust the property to change where and how annotations are displayed on the chart.

example.code:
// This example demonstrates how to render a chart with an annotation placed within the chart region:
Highest Medal Count

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAnnotation.X
member.summary: Gets or sets the X-coordinate value for the annotation.
member.value: If the coordinate unit is set to , this property specifies the axis value. Otherwise, it specifies the pixel or percentage of the coordinate. The default value is zero.
member.remarks: This property determines the horizontal position of the annotation based on the defined coordinate units. When the is set to Units.Pixel, the X value represents the number of pixels from the chart's left boundary. If set to Units.Point, it corresponds to a value along the horizontal axis.

example.code:
// This example demonstrates how to render a chart with an annotation using only the X coordinate:
Highest Medal Count

member.summary: Gets or sets the name of the horizontal axis associated with the annotation.

member.remarks: This property requires the presence of the 'Axes' of the chart.

example.code:

Highest Medal Count

member.value: If the coordinate unit is set to , this property specifies the axis value. Otherwise, it specifies the pixel or percentage of the coordinate. The default value is zero.
member.remarks: This property determines the vertical position of the annotation based on the defined coordinate units. member.summary: Gets or sets the font size of the chart subtitle.
member.value: A string representing the font size of the chart subtitle. he default size is determined by the Chart's theme. By default, the theme is set to with a subtitle text size of 14px.
member.remarks: Use the property to change the font size of subtitle text in the Chart. This property accepts standard CSS font-size specifications, such as values in 'px'.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartSubTitleStyle.FontWeight
member.summary: Gets or sets the font weight of the chart subtitle.
member.value: A string representing the font weight of the subtitle text. The default font weight is determined by the Chart's theme. By default, the theme is set to with subtitle font weight of 400.
member.remarks: The font weight can be a number (100 to 900), or a keyword such as 'normal', 'bold', 'bolder', or 'lighter'.

example.code: // The following code demonstrates setting a custom font weight for the subtitle text: <SfChart Title="Sales Data" SubTitle="2023 Overview"> <ChartSubTitleStyle FontWeight="600" /> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartSubTitleStyle.FontFamily
member.summary: Gets or sets the font family of the chart subtitle.
member.value: A string representing the font family of the subtitle text. The default font family is determined by the Chart's theme. By default, the theme is set to with a subtitle font family of Roboto.
member.remarks: The font family accepts typical CSS font family syntax, allowing customization to match the desired text style.

example.code: // The following code demonstrates setting a custom font family for the subtitle text: <SfChart Title="Sales Data" SubTitle="2023 Overview"> <ChartSubTitleStyle FontFamily="italic" /> </SfChart>

member.remarks: Use this property to provide an accessibility description for screen readers and other assistive technologies.

example.code: // The following code demonstrates setting an accessibility description for the subtitle text: <SfChart Title="Sales Data" SubTitle="2023 Overview"> <ChartSubTitleStyle AccessibilityDescription="This is the subtitle of the chart" /> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartSubTitleStyle.AccessibilityRole

example.code: // The following code demonstrates setting a custom font size for the title text: <SfChart Title="Chart"> <ChartTitleStyle Size="20px" /> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartTitleStyle.FontWeight
member.summary: Gets or sets the font weight of the chart title.
member.value: A string representing the font weight of the title text. The default font weight is determined by the Chart's theme. By default, the theme is set to with title font weight of 600.
member.remarks: The font weight can be a number (100 to 900), or a keyword such as 'normal', 'bold', 'bolder', or 'lighter'.

example.code: // The following code demonstrates setting a custom font weight for the title text: <SfChart Title="Chart"> <ChartTitleStyle FontWeight="400" /> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartTitleStyle.FontFamily
member.summary: Gets or sets the font family of the chart title.
member.value: A string representing the font family of the chart title. The default font family is determined by the chart's theme. By default, the theme is set to with the font family Roboto.
member.remarks: This property allows customization of the font family for the chart title, providing flexibility in text appearance and style.

example.code: // The following code demonstrates setting a custom font family for the title text: <SfChart Title="Chart"> <ChartTitleStyle FontFamily="italic" /> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartTitleStyle.Position
member.summary: Defines the position of the chart title and subtitle.
member.value: An enum value representing the position of the title. The default value is 'Top'.
member.remarks:
Available options:
Top Displays the title and subtitle at the top of the chart.
Left Displays the title and subtitle on the left side of the chart.
Bottom Displays the title and subtitle at the bottom of the chart.
Right Displays the title and subtitle on the right side of the chart.
Custom Displays the title and subtitle based on the specified X and Y coordinates.

example.code: // The following code demonstrates setting the position of the title. <SfChart Title="Sales Data" SubTitle="2023 Overview"> <ChartTitleStyle Position="ChartTitlePosition.Right" /> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartTitleStyle.X
member.summary: Defines the X coordinate for the chart title and subtitle.
member.value: A double value representing the horizontal position. The default value is 0.
member.remarks: This property is applicable only when the position is set to Custom.

example.code: // The following code demonstrates setting the X coordinate for the chart title. <SfChart Title="Sales Data" SubTitle="2023 Overview"> <ChartTitleStyle Position="ChartTitlePosition.Custom" X="40" /> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartTitleStyle.Y
member.summary: Defines the Y coordinate for the chart title and subtitle.
member.value: A double value representing the vertical position. The default value is 0.
member.remarks: This property is applicable only when the position is set to Custom.

example.code: // The following code demonstrates setting the Y coordinate for the chart title. <SfChart Title="Sales Data" SubTitle="2023 Overview"> <ChartTitleStyle Position="ChartTitlePosition.Custom" Y="40" /> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartTitleStyle.AccessibilityDescription
member.summary: Gets or sets the accessibility description for the chart title.
member.value: Accepts a string that defines the accessibility description for the chart title. The default value is an empty string.
member.remarks: Use this property to provide an accessibility description for screen readers and other assistive technologies.

example.code: // The following code demonstrates setting an accessibility description for the chart title: <SfChart Title="Chart"> <ChartTitleStyle AccessibilityDescription="This is the chart title" /> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartTitleStyle.AccessibilityRole
member.summary: Gets or sets the accessibility role for the chart title.
member.value: Accepts a string that defines the accessibility role for the chart title. The default value is null.
member.remarks: Use this property to provide an accessibility role for the chart title.

example.code: // The following code demonstrates setting an accessibility role for the chart title: <SfChart Title="Chart"> <ChartTitleStyle AccessibilityRole="heading" /> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartTitleStyle.Focusable
member.summary: Gets or sets the accessibility keyboard navigation focus option for the chart title.
member.value: Accepts the boolean value to enable or disable the keyboard navigation for the chart title. The default value is true.
member.remarks: Use this property to toggle the keyboard navigation focus for the chart title.

example.code: // The following code demonstrates setting the keyboard navigation focus for the chart title: <SfChart Title="Chart"> <ChartTitleStyle Focusable="false" /> </SfChart>

member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartColumn
member.summary: Provides options to customize the appearance of the chart column.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartColumn.BorderColor
member.summary: Gets or sets the color of the chart column border as a string.
member.value: A string representing the border color of the chart column. The default value is null.

example.code: // The following code demonstrates setting a divided chart area with custom column border colors: <SfChart> <ChartColumns> <ChartColumn Width="50%" BorderColor="red" /> <ChartColumn Width="50%" BorderColor="blue" /> </ChartColumns> <ChartAxes> <ChartAxis ColumnIndex="1" Name="XAxis" OpposedPosition="true" /> </ChartAxes> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y" /> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y1" XAxisName="XAxis" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartColumn.BorderWidth
member.summary: Gets or sets the width of the chart column border in pixels.
member.value: The double value representing the border width of the chart column. The default value is 1 pixel.
member.remarks: This property allows customization of the border width for the left line of the column, which divides the chart area horizontally.

example.code: // The following code demonstrates setting a divided chart area with custom column border width: <SfChart> <ChartColumns> <ChartColumn Width="50%" BorderColor="red" BorderWidth="2" /> <ChartColumn Width="50%" BorderColor="blue" BorderWidth="2" /> </ChartColumns> <ChartAxes> <ChartAxis ColumnIndex="1" Name="XAxis" OpposedPosition="true" /> </ChartAxes> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y" /> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y1" XAxisName="XAxis" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartColumn.Width
member.summary: Gets or sets the width of the column as a string, accepting input in the form of '100px' or '100%'.
member.value: A string representing the width of the column. The default value is "100%".
member.remarks: If specified as '100%', the column will render to the full width of its chart.

example.code: // The following code demonstrates setting a divided chart area with custom column: <SfChart> <ChartColumns> <ChartColumn Width="50%" /> <ChartColumn Width="50%" /> </ChartColumns> <ChartAxes> <ChartAxis ColumnIndex="1" Name="XAxis" /> </ChartAxes> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y" /> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y1" XAxisName="XAxis" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartRow.BorderWidth
member.summary: Gets or sets the width of the chart row border in pixels.

member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis
member.summary: Represents an axis within a chart, providing customization options for the axis's appearance and behavior.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.IsIndexed
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the category axis should be rendered using the data source index values.
member.value: true if the category axis should be rendered based on the data source index values; otherwise, false. The default value is false.
member.remarks: If set to true, multiple series will be rendered based on their data source index values. Each series will be aligned based on the index of data points rather than matching the category names.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to enable indexed category axis: <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis IsIndexed="true" ValueType="Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ValueType.Category" /> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports1" XName="X" YName="Y" /> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports2" XName="X" YName="Y" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.IsInversed
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the axis should be rendered in an inversed manner.
member.value: true if the axis should be rendered in an inversed manner; otherwise, false. The default value is false.
member.remarks: If set to true, the axis will be rendered with the greatest value on the axis moving closer to the origin, and vice versa.

example.code: // The following code demonstrates how to reverse the axis labels for both the x and y axes: <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis IsInversed="true" /> <ChartPrimaryYAxis IsInversed="true" /> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.Name
member.summary: Gets or sets the unique identifier name of an axis.
member.value: A string representing the unique identifier name of the axis. The default value is an empty string.
member.remarks: To associate an axis with the series, set this name to the xAxisName/yAxisName properties of the series.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to set the name of the axis: <SfChart> <ChartAxes> <ChartAxis OpposedPosition="true" RowIndex="1" Name="YAxis" /> </ChartAxes> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y"/> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y1" YAxisName="YAxis" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.OpposedPosition
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether to place an axis in the opposite position of its original position.
member.value: true if the axis should render at the opposite position; otherwise, false. The default value is false.
member.remarks: For a horizontal axis, setting to true will position the axis at the top of the chart. For a vertical axis, setting to true will position the axis at the right side of the chart.

example.code: // The following code demonstrates how to oppose-position the axis labels for both the x and y axes: <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis OpposedPosition="true" /> <ChartPrimaryYAxis OpposedPosition="true" /> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.Title
member.summary: Gets or sets the title of an axis.
member.value: A string representing the title of the axis. The default value is an empty string.
member.remarks: The axis title provides a quick information to the user about the data plotted in the axis.

example.code: // The following code demonstrates how to set the title to the axis labels for both the x and y axes: <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis Title="XAxis" /> <ChartPrimaryYAxis Title="YAxis" /> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.ValueType
member.summary: Gets or sets the type of data the axis is handling.
member.value:
One of the enumerations that specifies the value type of the axis. Options include: - Double: Renders a numeric axis. - DateTime: Renders a date time axis. - Category: Renders a category axis. - Logarithmic: Renders a logarithmic axis. - DateTimeCategory : Renders a date time category axis.
The default value is ValueType.Double.
member.remarks: This property determines the type of data the axis is handling, and it affects the way axis values are interpreted and displayed on the chart. It is essential to set this property correctly based on the nature of the data being plotted.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.Visible
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the axis elements such as axis labels, tick lines, grid lines, and axis title should be visible.
member.value: true if the axis and its associated elements are visible; otherwise, false. The default value is true.
member.remarks: Set this property to control the visibility of various axis elements. When set to false, the axis and its associated elements will not be rendered on the chart.

example.code: // The following code demonstrates how to set the visibility of the axis: <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis Visible="true" /> <ChartPrimaryYAxis Visible="false" /> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.Coefficient
member.summary: Gets or sets the radius for polar and radar series charts.
member.value: The double value represents the radius for polar and radar series charts. The default value is 100.
member.remarks: Applicable only for Polar and Radar series type charts.

example.code: // The following code demonstrates how to set the radius for polar and radar series charts: <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis Coefficient="60" /> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y" Type="ChartSeriesType.Polar" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.ColumnIndex
member.summary: Gets or sets the index of the column with which the axis is associated.
member.value: The index of the column associated with the axis. The default value is 0.
member.remarks: This property is applicable only when the chart area is divided into multiple plot areas using the . To bind a horizonatal axis to a specific column, set the axis’s ColumnIndex property to that column’s index.

example.code: // The following code demonstrates setting a divided chart area with multiple columns and binding a horizontal axis to a specific column: <SfChart> <ChartColumns> <ChartColumn Width="50%" /> <ChartColumn Width="50%" /> </ChartColumns> <ChartAxes> <ChartAxis ColumnIndex="1" Name="XAxis" /> </ChartAxes> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y" /> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y1" XAxisName="XAxis" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.CrossesAt
member.summary: Gets or sets the value (numeric, datetime, or logarithmic) at which the horizontal axis line intersects with the vertical axis or vice versa.
member.value: The value at which the horizontal axis line intersects with the vertical axis or vice versa. The default value is null.
member.remarks: If the of the horizontal axis is ValueType.Category, the value for the vertical axis is accepted as a numeric value, which will be considered as the index of horizontal axis labels.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to create a chart with a secondary Y-axis that crosses at zero: <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis ValueType="Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ValueType.Category" /> <ChartAxes> <ChartAxis Minimum="-10" Maximum="10" Interval="1" OpposedPosition="true" RowIndex="1" Name="YAxis" CrossesAt="0" /> </ChartAxes> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y" Type="ChartSeriesType.Column" /> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y1" YAxisName="YAxis" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.CrossesInAxis
member.summary: Gets or sets the name of the axis with which the axis line is to be crossed.
member.value: The name of the axis with which the axis line is crossed.
member.remarks: Applicable only when is provided with a value.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to create a chart with a secondary Y-axis named "YAxis" that crosses the primary X-axis at zero: <SfChart> <ChartAxes> <ChartAxis Minimum="-10" Maximum="10" Interval="1" OpposedPosition="true" RowIndex="1" Name="YAxis" CrossesAt="0" /> </ChartAxes> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y" Type="ChartSeriesType.Column" /> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y1" YAxisName="YAxis" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.Description
member.summary: Gets or sets the description about the axis and its elements for accessibility purposes.
member.value: A string representing the description about the axis and its elements for accessibility. The default value is an empty string.
member.remarks: Accepts the values in string.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to set the description for the primary X-axis in a chart: <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis Description="Primary X-Axis" /> <ChartPrimaryYAxis Description="Primary Y-Axis" /> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.DesiredIntervals
member.summary: Gets or sets a value that indicates the approximate interval count for axis interval calculation.
member.value: The desired interval count for axis interval calculation. The default value is .
member.remarks: Not applicable when of the axis is ValueType.Category.

example.code: // The following code demonstrates how to set the desired number of intervals on the X-axis: <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis DesiredIntervals="1" /> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.EdgeLabelPlacement
member.summary: Gets or sets the placement of labels at the edge of the axis.
member.value:
One of the enumerations that specify the edge label placement for the axis. The options include: - None: No action will be performed, and the label will be rendered as it is. - Hide: Hides the edge label if it exceeds the chart area. - Shift: Shifts the edge labels within the chart area.
The default mode is EdgeLabelPlacement.None.
member.remarks: The longer text labels at the axis edges may only be partially visible in the chart. Utilize this property to place the edge labels efficiently for a better user experience.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to hide edge labels on the primary axis in a chart: <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis EdgeLabelPlacement="EdgeLabelPlacement.Hide" /> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.EnableAutoIntervalOnZooming
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the axis interval should be calculated automatically with respect to the zoomed range.
member.value: true if automatic interval calculation is enabled during zooming; otherwise, false. The default value is true.
member.remarks: This property affects axis intervals only when the chart is zoomed.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to set the EnableAutoIntervalOnZooming for the axis: <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis EnableAutoIntervalOnZooming="true/> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y"/> </ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartZoomSettings EnableSelectionZooming="true"></ChartZoomSettings> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.EnableScrollbarOnZooming
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the scrollbar for zooming is enabled.
member.value: true if the scrollbar for zooming is enabled; otherwise, false. The default value is true.
member.remarks: If set to true, the axis will be rendered with a scrollbar when the chart is zoomed.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to set the EnableScrollbarOnZooming for the axis: <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis EnableScrollbarOnZooming="true" /> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y"/> </ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartZoomSettings EnableSelectionZooming="true"></ChartZoomSettings> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.EnableTrim
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether axis labels should be trimmed when they exceed the .
member.value: true if axis labels should be trimmed; otherwise, false. The default value is false.
member.remarks: If set to true, axis labels which exceed the will be trimmed regardless of the applied.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to trim long labels on the axis and restrict them to a maximum width in a chart: <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis ValueType="Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ValueType.Category" MaximumLabelWidth="20" EnableTrim="true" /> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@MedalDetails" XName="X" YName="YValue" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.IntervalType
member.summary: Gets or sets the interval type for the DateTime-based axis.
member.value:
One of the enumerations that specifies the interval type for the DateTime-based axis. The options include: - Auto: Defines the interval of the axis based on data. - Years: Defines the interval of the axis in years. - Months: Defines the interval of the axis in months. - Days: Defines the interval of the axis in days. - Hours: Defines the interval of the axis in hours. - Minutes: Defines the interval of the axis in minutes.
The default value is IntervalType.Auto.
member.remarks: Choosing an appropriate interval type is essential for displaying DateTime data effectively. For instance, using a larger interval such as Years or Months may be more suitable for data spanning extended periods, while shorter intervals like Hours or Minutes are better suited for data requiring more detailed temporal granularity. Adjusting the interval type helps in achieving clarity and precision in your chart’s time representation.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to configure the axis to display DateTime values and to show labels at monthly intervals in a Syncfusion Blazor chart: <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis ValueType="Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ValueType.DateTime" IntervalType="IntervalType.Months" /> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.Interval
member.summary: Gets or sets the interval for the axis.
member.value: The numeric value representing the interval for the axis. The default value is .
member.remarks: The interval can be customized using for DateTime-based axis and for logarithmic-based axis. For example, if the interval is set to 2 and the is set to Years, it considers 2 years to be the interval.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to set a custom interval of 2 for the axis in a chart: <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis Interval="2" /> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.Minimum
member.summary: Gets or sets the minimum range of an axis.
member.value: The value representing the minimum range of an axis. The default value is derived from the values of corresponding data source points.
member.remarks: This property specifies the minimum range for the axis. It determines the lower limit of the visible range on the axis.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to set a custom minimum value for the axis in a Syncfusion Blazor chart: <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis Minimum="-10" /> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.LabelPlacement
member.summary: Gets or sets a value that specifies the placement of axis labels with respect to the axis tick lines.
member.value:
One of the enumerations that specifies the placement for the axis labels. The options include: - BetweenTicks: Renders the label between the ticks. - OnTicks: Renders the label on the ticks.
The default value is LabelPlacement.BetweenTicks.
member.remarks: The placement of axis labels can have a significant impact on the readability and accuracy of the chart. When labels are placed BetweenTicks, they are centered between tick marks, often used to represent categories or ranges accurately. Alternatively, when labels are placed OnTicks, they align directly with the tick marks, which can be beneficial for pinpointing specific values or time points. Choosing the appropriate label placement contributes to better data comprehension and presentation.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to position the axis labels on the tick: <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis LabelPlacement="LabelPlacement.OnTicks" ValueType="Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ValueType.Category" /> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@MedalDetails" XName="X" YName="Y" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.Maximum
member.summary: Gets or sets the maximum range of an axis.
member.value: The value representing the maximum range of an axis. The default value is derived from the values of corresponding data source points.
member.remarks: This property specifies the maximum range for the axis. It determines the upper limit of the visible range on the axis.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to set a maximum value for the axis in chart: <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis Maximum="20" /> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.ZoomFactor
member.summary: Gets or sets the scaling factor for the axis during zoom operations.
member.value: The scaling factor for the axis, which ranges from 0 to 1. The default value is 1.
member.remarks: When is set to 0.5, the chart is scaled by 200% along this axis.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to set the ZoomFactor of the axis to zoom into the chart: <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis ZoomFactor="0.5" /> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.ZoomPosition
member.summary: Gets or sets the position of the zoomed axis during zoom operations.
member.value: The position of the zoomed axis, which ranges from 0 to 1.
member.remarks: The ZoomPosition property determines the relative position of the zoomed axis during zoom operations. A value of 0 represents the start of the axis, and a value of 1 represents the end of the axis. This property is used in conjunction with the property to control the zoom behavior along the axis.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to configure the ZoomFactor and ZoomPosition for the X-axis: <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis ZoomFactor="0.5" ZoomPosition="0.6" /> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.LabelFormat
member.summary: Gets or sets a value that is used to format the numeric, logarithmic, and datetime labels to all globalize formats. Axis also supports custom label format using placeholders such as {value}K, where the value represents the axis label.
member.value: A string representing the format for processing numeric, logarithmic, and datetime labels.
member.remarks: The supports standard and custom formatting strings. For numeric values, formats like "C", "N", "P", etc., can be applied. For datetime values, formats like "d", "D", "t", etc., are supported. The property is not applicable to category axis labels.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to apply a currency format to the axis labels: <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis LabelFormat="c" /> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.LabelIntersectAction
member.summary: Gets or sets a value that specifies how to arrange axis labels intelligently when they intersect with each other.
member.value:
One of the enumerations that specifies the alignment of axis labels when they intersect. The options include: - None: Show all labels, regardless of intersections. - Hide: Hide labels that intersect with each other. - Trim: Trim labels to fit within the available space when they intersect. - Wrap: Wrap labels to multiple lines when they intersect. - MultipleRows: Display labels in multiple rows when they intersect. - Rotate45: Rotate labels by 45 degrees when they intersect. - Rotate90: Rotate labels by 90 degrees when they intersect.
The default LabelIntersectAction is LabelIntersectAction.Trim.
member.remarks: Note: For the vertical axis, the option is the only applicable choice.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to apply a rotate 45 degrees to the axis labels: <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis LabelIntersectAction="LabelIntersectAction.Rotate45" /> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.LabelPadding
member.summary: Gets or sets the padding for axis labels from the axis line in pixels.
member.value: The numeric value representing the label padding from the axis line in pixels. The default value is 5.
member.remarks: Increasing the padding can prevent labels from overlapping with the axis line, ensuring clear visibility. Conversely, reducing the padding can create a more compact layout, useful for fitting charts into limited spaces. It is important to consider the overall design and label size when setting this value to maintain a clean and readable chart display.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.LabelPosition
member.summary: Gets or sets the position of axis labels relative to the axis line.
member.value:
One of the enumerations that specifies the position of labels relative to the axis line. The options include: - Inside: Renders the labels inside the axis line. - Outside: Renders the labels outside the axis line.
The default value is AxisPosition.Outside.
member.remarks: Placing labels inside the axis line (Inside) might be beneficial when you have limited space or when you want a minimal chart appearance. Conversely, placing labels outside the axis line (Outside) can enhance visibility and separation from the chart area, particularly in situations where overlapping with data points or elements might occur. It is important to consider the overall chart layout and data presentation needs when setting this property.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to position the axis labels inside the chart area. <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis LabelPosition="AxisPosition.Inside" /> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.LabelRotation

member.value: A double value representing the rotation angle of the axis labels. The default value is 0.
member.remarks: This property specifies the rotation angle applied to axis labels, which can enhance their orientation and improve readability. It accepts numerical values ranging from 0 to 360 degrees. Negative values indicate angles that are calculated in a opposite direction, starting from 360 degrees. Setting this property allows for customizing how the labels are presented along the axis, accommodating various layout needs.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to rotate the axis labels on the axis. <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis LabelRotation="45" /> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.RangePadding
member.summary: Gets or sets a value that specifies the padding for the axis range in terms of interval.
member.value:
One of the enumerations that specifies the range padding of the axis. The options include: - None: Padding cannot be applied to the axis. - Normal: Padding is applied to the axis based on the range calculation. - Additional: Interval of the axis is added as padding to the minimum and maximum values of the range. - Round: Axis range is rounded to the nearest possible value divisible by the interval.
The default value is ChartRangePadding.Auto.
member.remarks: This setting ensures clarity and better axis range handling by allowing extra space or precise boundary control as necessary.

member.value: A string representing the color of the axis line. The default value is #b5b5b5.
member.remarks: Use valid hex or rgba CSS color strings for the color value to ensure the correct presentation of the axis line in charts.

example.code: // The following code demonstrates setting a customize color for the axis line. <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis> <ChartAxisLineStyle Width="3" Color="red" /> </ChartPrimaryXAxis> <ChartPrimaryYAxis> <ChartAxisLineStyle Width="3" Color="red" /> </ChartPrimaryYAxis> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxisLineStyle.DashArray
member.summary: Gets or sets the dash array of the axis line.
member.value: A string representing the dash array of the axis line. The default value is an empty string.
member.remarks: This property allows customization of the axis line's stroke pattern. Use a series of numbers to define the dash and gap lengths (e.g., "5,2,1" for a pattern of 5px dash, 2px gap, 1px dash).

example.code: // The following code demonstrates setting a customize color for the axis line. <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis> <ChartAxisLineStyle Width="3" DashArray="5,1" /> </ChartPrimaryXAxis> <ChartPrimaryYAxis> <ChartAxisLineStyle Width="3" DashArray="5,1" /> </ChartPrimaryYAxis> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxisLineStyle.Width
member.summary: Gets or sets the width of the axis line in pixels.
member.value: The double value representing the width of the axis line in pixels. The default value is 1.
member.remarks: This property specifies the thickness of the axis line, allowing for visual emphasis as necessary.

example.code: // The following code demonstrates setting a customize width for the axis line. <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis> <ChartAxisLineStyle Width="3" /> </ChartPrimaryXAxis> <ChartPrimaryYAxis> <ChartAxisLineStyle Width="3" /> </ChartPrimaryYAxis> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxisMultiLevelLabelBorder
member.summary: Provides the options to customize the multilevel label border for a chart axis, including color, border type, and width.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxisMultiLevelLabelBorder.Color
member.summary: Gets or sets the color of the multi-level labels border.
member.value: A string representing the color of the multi-level labels border. The default multi-level label border color is determined by the chart's theme. By default, the theme is set to with a font color of #b5b5b5. The default value is an empty string.
member.remarks: Use valid hex or rgba CSS color strings for the color value.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to apply a colored border to a multi-level label on the X-axis. <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis> <ChartMultiLevelLabels> <ChartMultiLevelLabel> <ChartAxisMultiLevelLabelBorder Color="blue" /> <ChartCategories> <ChartCategory Start="10" End="40" Text="Half yearly 1" /> </ChartCategories> </ChartMultiLevelLabel> </ChartMultiLevelLabels> </ChartPrimaryXAxis> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@Data" XName="XValue" YName="YValue" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxisMultiLevelLabelBorder.Type
member.summary: Gets or sets the border type for multi-level labels.
member.value:
One of the enumerations that specifies the border type for multi-level labels. The options include: - Rectangle - Renders the border in a rectangular shape around the label. - WithoutTopBorder - Renders the border without the top edge around the label. - WithoutTopandBottomBorder - Renders the border without both top and bottom edges around the label. - WithoutBorder - Renders the label without any border. - Brace - Renders the border with a brace-like shape around the label. - CurlyBrace - Renders the border with a curly brace-like shape around the label.
The default value is BorderType.Rectangle.
member.remarks: This property determines the style of the border around multi-level labels.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to apply a curly brace border to a multi-level label on the X-axis <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis> <ChartMultiLevelLabels> <ChartMultiLevelLabel> <ChartAxisMultiLevelLabelBorder Type="BorderType.CurlyBrace" /> <ChartCategories> <ChartCategory Start="10" End="40" Text="Half yearly 1" /> </ChartCategories> </ChartMultiLevelLabel> </ChartMultiLevelLabels> </ChartPrimaryXAxis> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@Data" XName="XValue" YName="YValue" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxisMultiLevelLabelBorder.Width
member.summary: Gets or sets the width of the multi-level labels border in pixels.
member.value: The width of the border in pixels. The default value is 1.
member.remarks: This property specifies the thickness of the border.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to set the border width for a multi-level label on the X-axis. <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis> <ChartMultiLevelLabels> <ChartMultiLevelLabel> <ChartAxisMultiLevelLabelBorder Width="3" /> <ChartCategories> <ChartCategory Start="10" End="40" Text="Half yearly 1" /> </ChartCategories> </ChartMultiLevelLabel> </ChartMultiLevelLabels> </ChartPrimaryXAxis> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@Data" XName="XValue" YName="YValue" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartCategory.Type
member.summary: Gets or sets the border type for the individual multi-level label.
member.value:
One of the enumerations that specifies the border type for the individual multi-level label. The options include: - Rectangle - Renders the border in a rectangular shape around the label. - WithoutTopBorder - Renders the border without the top edge around the label. - WithoutTopandBottomBorder - Renders the border without both top and bottom edges around the label. - WithoutBorder - Renders the label without any border. - Brace - Renders the border with a brace-like shape around the label. - CurlyBrace - Renders the border with a curly brace-like shape around the label.
The default value is BorderType.Auto.

member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartMultiLevelLabel
member.summary: Provides options to customize the multi-level label of the axis in a chart.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartMultiLevelLabel.Alignment
member.summary: Gets or sets the alignment of the multi-level labels in the chart.
member.value: One of the enumeration values that specifies the positioning of the multi-level labels. The options include: - Near: Aligns labels at the start of the multi-level label rectangle (left for horizontal orientation, top for vertical orientation). - Center: Centers the multi-level labels within the rectangle. - Far: Aligns labels at the end of the multi-level label rectangle (right for horizontal orientation, bottom for vertical orientation). The default value is Alignment.Center.
member.remarks: This property determines how the multi-level labels are positioned relative to their placeholder rectangle, providing flexibility in label presentation. Proper alignment can enhance the readability and visual appeal of chart data.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to alignment the multi-level axis label text in chart. <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis> <ChartMultiLevelLabels> <ChartMultiLevelLabel Alignment="Alignment.Far"> <ChartCategories> <ChartCategory Start="10" End="40" Text="Half yearly 1" /> </ChartCategories> </ChartMultiLevelLabel> </ChartMultiLevelLabels> </ChartPrimaryXAxis> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@Data" XName="XValue" YName="YValue" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartMultiLevelLabel.Overflow
member.summary: Gets or sets the text overflow behavior for multi-level labels.
member.value:
One of the enumeration values specifying text overflow options. Options include: - TextOverflow.Trim: Trims text exceeding defined margins. - TextOverflow.Wrap: Wraps text exceeding defined margins. - TextOverflow.None: Displays text without modification.
The default value is TextOverflow.Wrap.
member.remarks: This property controls how multilevel label text is displayed when space is constrained, allowing for trimming, wrapping, or full display.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to trim the multi-level axis label text using the Overflow property. <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis> <ChartMultiLevelLabels> <ChartMultiLevelLabel Overflow="TextOverflow.Trim"> <ChartCategories> <ChartCategory Start="10" End="13" Text="Half yearly 1" /> </ChartCategories> </ChartMultiLevelLabel> </ChartMultiLevelLabels> </ChartPrimaryXAxis> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@Data" XName="XValue" YName="YValue" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartCommonScrollbarSettings.Position

Available options include:

Bottom: Positions the scrollbar at the bottom of the chart. Applicable only to horizontal scrollbars.
Left: Positions the scrollbar on the left side of the chart. Applicable only to vertical scrollbars.
Right: Positions the scrollbar on the right side of the chart. Applicable only to vertical scrollbars.

The default value is Anchor.Middle.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to align the stripline text at the start of the Y-axis using the HorizontalAlignment property. <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryYAxis> <ChartStriplines> <ChartStripline Start="20" End="25" HorizontalAlignment="Anchor.Start" Text="Yaxis"> </ChartStripline> </ChartStriplines> </ChartPrimaryYAxis> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@Data" XName="XValue" YName="YValue" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.value: true if the strip line should be repeated; otherwise, false. The default value is false.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartStripline.Opacity
member.summary: Gets or sets the opacity of the strip line.

example.code: // Demonstrates the use of the SegmentAxisName property to render a stripline within a specified axis segment. <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis LabelFormat="yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss tt" Interval="5" IntervalType="IntervalType.Minutes" ValueType="Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ValueType.DateTime"> <ChartStriplines> <ChartStripline Start="new DateTime(2016, 06, 13, 08, 00, 00)" End="new DateTime(2016, 06, 13, 08, 05, 00)" SegmentAxisName="PrimaryYAxis" SegmentStart="1.8" SegmentEnd="2.2" /> </ChartStriplines> </ChartPrimaryXAxis> <ChartPrimaryYAxis Interval="0.5" Minimum="0" Maximum="3.5" /> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries Fill="blue" DataSource="@StepLineData" Width="2" XName="X" YName="Y" Type="Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartSeriesType.StepLine" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartStripline.SegmentEnd
member.summary: Gets or sets the end value of the strip line segment.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartStripline.SegmentStart
member.summary: Gets or sets the start value of the strip line segment.
member.value: The start value of the strip line segment. The default value is null.
member.remarks: This property determines where the segment begins, providing control over the length and extent of the strip line.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to define a stripline with specific segment boundaries using SegmentStart and SegmentEnd. // The stripline spans from 08:00 to 08:05 on the X-axis and between 1.8 and 2.2 on the Y-axis, creating a rectangular band. <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis LabelFormat="yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss tt" Interval="5" IntervalType="IntervalType.Minutes" ValueType="Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ValueType.DateTime"> <ChartStriplines> <ChartStripline Start="new DateTime(2016, 06, 13, 08, 00, 00)" End="new DateTime(2016, 06, 13, 08, 05, 00)" SegmentStart="1.8" SegmentEnd="2.2" /> </ChartStriplines> </ChartPrimaryXAxis> <ChartPrimaryYAxis Interval="0.5" Minimum="0" Maximum="3.5"></ChartPrimaryYAxis> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries Fill="blue" DataSource="@StepLineData" Width="2" XName="X" YName="Y" Type="Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartSeriesType.StepLine"> </ChartSeries> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartStripline.Size
member.summary: Gets or sets the size of the strip line based on the value and the axis value type.
member.value: The size of the strip line. This property determines the extent or length of the strip line on the chart. The default value is 0.
member.remarks: For example, if is set to true, and the Size is 4 on a Category axis, the strip line will be rendered over 4 category values from the origin.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to use the StartFromAxis and Size properties of a stripline to span a fixed size from the axis. <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryYAxis> <ChartStriplines> <ChartStripline StartFromAxis="true" Size="30"> </ChartStripline> </ChartStriplines> </ChartPrimaryYAxis> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@Data" XName="XValue" YName="YValue" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartStripline.SizeType
member.summary: Gets or sets the size type of the strip line.
member.value:
One of the enumerations that specifies the unit of strip line size. The options include: - Auto - Automatically determines the appropriate unit based on the data. - Pixel - Measures the size in pixels. - Years - Measures the size in years for date-time axis. - Months - Measures the size in months for date-time axis. - Days - Measures the size in days for date-time axis. - Hours - Measures the size in hours for date-time axis. - Minutes - Measures the size in minutes for date-time axis. - Seconds - Measures the size in seconds for date-time axis.
The default value is SizeType.Auto.
member.remarks: This property allows for flexible sizing of strip lines in both time-based and pixel-based units.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to render a chart with a primary X-axis that includes a stripline with a specified size type. <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis IntervalType="IntervalType.Minutes" ValueType="Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ValueType.DateTime"> <ChartStriplines> <ChartStripline Start="new DateTime(2016, 06, 13, 08, 00, 00)" End="new DateTime(2016, 06, 13, 08, 05, 00)" Color="#E0E0E0" IsSegmented="true" SegmentStart="1.8" SegmentAxisName="PrimaryYAxis" SegmentEnd="2.2" StartFromAxis="false" SizeType="SizeType.Minutes" /> </ChartStriplines> </ChartPrimaryXAxis> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@StepLineData" XName="X" YName="Y" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartStripline.Start
member.summary: Gets or sets the start value of the strip line.
member.value: An object representing the start value of the strip line. The default value is null.
member.remarks: This property determines where the strip line begins along the axis. Based on the axis type, the value will be assigned.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to set a start value for a stripline on the primary Y-axis. <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryYAxis> <ChartStriplines> <ChartStripline Start="20" End="25" /> </ChartStriplines> </ChartPrimaryYAxis> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@Data" XName="XValue" YName="YValue" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartStripline.StartFromAxis
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the strip line should be rendered from the axis origin.
member.value: true if the strip line should be rendered from the axis origin; otherwise, false. The default value is false.
member.remarks: This property allows you to control whether the strip line starts from the axis origin or from a specified value. If set to true, the stripline will be rendered from the axis origin, ignoring the value if provided.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to render a stripline on the Y-axis starting directly from the axis line. <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryYAxis> <ChartStriplines> <ChartStripline Start="18" End="25" StartFromAxis="true"> </ChartStripline> </ChartStriplines> </ChartPrimaryYAxis> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@Data" XName="XValue" YName="YValue" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartStripline.Text
member.summary: Gets or sets the text for the strip line.
member.value: A string representing the strip line text. The default value is an empty string.
member.remarks: This property is used to assign a label or descriptive text to the strip line, which can enhance the interpretability of charts by providing contextual information directly on the visual elements. If the text is not set, the strip line will appear without a label, maintaining a cleaner visual appearance but potentially lacking descriptive context.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to display a stripline with a text label on the Y-axis. <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryYAxis> <ChartStriplines> <ChartStripline Start="18" End="25" Text="Strip-line"> </ChartStripline> </ChartStriplines> </ChartPrimaryYAxis> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@Data" XName="XValue" YName="YValue" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartStripline.TextStyle
member.summary: Gets or sets an instance of which defines the stripline text style.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartStripline.VerticalAlignment
member.summary: Gets or sets a value that specifies the position of the strip line text vertically.
