member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDefaultConnector
member.summary: Provides options for customizing the connector line style.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDefaultConnector.Type
member.summary: Gets or sets the type of the connector line.
member.value:
One of the enumerations that specifies the type of the connector line. The options include: - Line: Renders the connector line as a straight line. - Curve: Renders the connector line as a curved line.
The default type is ConnectorType.Line.
member.remarks: This property defines how the connector appears in the chart, allowing customization to either a straight or curved style for better visual representation.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDefaultConnector.Color
member.summary: Gets or sets the color of the connector line.
member.value: A string representing the color of the connector line. The default value is "black".
member.remarks: Accepts values in hex or rgba as a valid CSS color string. It allows customization of the connector line to match the chart's theme or styling preferences.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDefaultConnector.Width
member.summary: Gets or sets the width of the connector line.
member.value: A double value representing the width of the connector line. The default value is 1.
member.remarks: Adjust this property to change the thickness of the connector line for better visibility or styling.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDefaultConnector.Length
member.summary: Gets or sets the length of the connector line.
member.value: A string representing the length of the connector line. The default value is null.
member.remarks: The length can be specified as a string that defines how far the connector extends, allowing dynamic adjustments based on layout requirements.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDefaultConnector.DashArray
member.summary: Gets or sets the dashArray for the connector line.
member.value: A string representing the dashArray for the connector line. The default value is null.
member.remarks: The property allows customization of the connector line by specifying a dash pattern. This string value defines the pattern of dashes and gaps in the line. For example, "4,2" represents a dash of length 4 followed by a gap of length 2.

member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDefaultAnimation
member.summary: Provides options for animation in the chart component.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDefaultAnimation.Delay
member.summary: Gets or sets the delay for the animation of the series.
member.value: A representing the delay in milliseconds before the animation starts. The default value is 0.
member.remarks: Use this property to specify how long the chart should wait before beginning the animation. This can help in synchronizing complex animations or staggering them for visual effects.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDefaultAnimation.Duration
member.summary: Gets or sets the duration of the animation in milliseconds.
member.value: A representing the total time span of the animation in milliseconds. The default value is 1000.
member.remarks: Adjusting this property allows you to speed up or slow down the animation, making it more visually appealing based on the specific chart's context.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDefaultAnimation.Enable
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the series is animated on initial loading.
member.value: true if the series animation is enabled on initial load; otherwise, false. The default value is true.
member.remarks: Setting this property to true makes the series elements animate when the chart first loads, enhancing the visual engagement of the chart presentation. Disable it for static displays.

member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDefaultBorder
member.summary: Provides options for customizing the color and width of the border.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDefaultBorder.Color
member.summary: Gets or sets the color of the border, accepting values in hexadecimal or RGBA formats as valid CSS color strings.
member.value: A string that specifies the color of the chart border. The value must be a valid CSS color string, formatted as either a hexadecimal or RGBA value.
member.remarks: Changing this property will update the visual boundary of the chart's border to match the specified color, enhancing the stylistic appearance or aligning with specific design standards.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to set all the borders used in the chart control. <SfChart> <ChartBorder Color="blue" Width="1"></ChartBorder> <ChartArea> <ChartAreaBorder Width="2" Color="green"></ChartAreaBorder> </ChartArea> <ChartPrimaryXAxis ValueType="Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ValueType.Category"> <ChartAxisCrosshairTooltip Enable="true"></ChartAxisCrosshairTooltip> </ChartPrimaryXAxis> <ChartPrimaryYAxis> <ChartStriplines> <ChartStripline Start="20" End="25" Color="red"> <ChartStriplineBorder Color="#4b107e" Width="2"></ChartStriplineBorder> </ChartStripline> <ChartStripline Start="32" End="35" Color="blue"> <ChartStriplineBorder Color="#d41986" Width="2"></ChartStriplineBorder> </ChartStripline> </ChartStriplines> </ChartPrimaryYAxis> <ChartCrosshairSettings Enable="true"> <ChartCrosshairLine Width="2" Color="green"></ChartCrosshairLine> </ChartCrosshairSettings> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@MedalDetails" Name="Gold" XName="Country" YName="Gold" Type="ChartSeriesType.Column"> <ChartEmptyPointSettings Mode="EmptyPointMode.Average"> <ChartEmptyPointBorder Width="1" Color="brown"></ChartEmptyPointBorder> </ChartEmptyPointSettings> <ChartSeriesBorder Width="1" Color="black"></ChartSeriesBorder> <ChartMarker Visible="true"> <ChartMarkerBorder Width="2" Color="red"></ChartMarkerBorder> <ChartDataLabel Visible="true"> <ChartDataLabelBorder Width="2" Color="red"></ChartDataLabelBorder> </ChartDataLabel> </ChartMarker> </ChartSeries> </ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartLegendSettings Visible="true"> <ChartLegendBorder Color="red" Width="2" /> </ChartLegendSettings> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDefaultBorder.Width
member.summary: Gets or sets the width of the border in pixels.
member.value: A specifying the border's width. The default value is 1, representing 1 pixel.
member.remarks: Adjust this property to increase or decrease the thickness of the chart border, which can help draw focus or emphasize the chart's outline.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to set all the borders used in the chart control. <SfChart> <ChartBorder Color="blue" Width="1"></ChartBorder> <ChartArea> <ChartAreaBorder Width="2" Color="green"></ChartAreaBorder> </ChartArea> <ChartPrimaryXAxis ValueType="Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ValueType.Category"> <ChartAxisCrosshairTooltip Enable="true"></ChartAxisCrosshairTooltip> </ChartPrimaryXAxis> <ChartPrimaryYAxis> <ChartStriplines> <ChartStripline Start="20" End="25" Color="red"> <ChartStriplineBorder Color="#4b107e" Width="2"></ChartStriplineBorder> </ChartStripline> <ChartStripline Start="32" End="35" Color="blue"> <ChartStriplineBorder Color="#d41986" Width="2"></ChartStriplineBorder> </ChartStripline> </ChartStriplines> </ChartPrimaryYAxis> <ChartCrosshairSettings Enable="true"> <ChartCrosshairLine Width="2" Color="green"></ChartCrosshairLine> </ChartCrosshairSettings> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@MedalDetails" Name="Gold" XName="Country" YName="Gold" Type="ChartSeriesType.Column"> <ChartEmptyPointSettings Mode="EmptyPointMode.Average"> <ChartEmptyPointBorder Width="1" Color="brown"></ChartEmptyPointBorder> </ChartEmptyPointSettings> <ChartSeriesBorder Width="1" Color="black"></ChartSeriesBorder> <ChartMarker Visible="true"> <ChartMarkerBorder Width="2" Color="red"></ChartMarkerBorder> <ChartDataLabel Visible="true"> <ChartDataLabelBorder Width="2" Color="red"></ChartDataLabelBorder> </ChartDataLabel> </ChartMarker> </ChartSeries> </ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartLegendSettings Visible="true"> <ChartLegendBorder Color="red" Width="2" /> </ChartLegendSettings> </SfChart>

member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDefaultFont
member.summary: Provides options for customizing the text style of the chart component.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDefaultFont.Color
member.summary: Gets or sets the color for the text.
member.value: A string representing the color for the text. The default value is null.
member.remarks: Accepts values in hex and rgba as a valid CSS color string.

example.code: // The following code demonstrates setting a custom font color for the text. <SfChart Title="Olympic Medals" SubTitle="In the year 2023"> <ChartTitleStyle Color="black"></ChartTitleStyle> <ChartSubTitleStyleColor="blue"></ChartSubTitleStyle> <ChartPrimaryXAxis Title="Country" ValueType="Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ValueType.Category"> <ChartAxisCrosshairTooltip Enable="true"> <ChartCrosshairTextStyle Color="red"></ChartCrosshairTextStyle> </ChartAxisCrosshairTooltip> <ChartAxisLabelStyle Color="green"></ChartAxisLabelStyle> <ChartAxisTitleStyle Color="red"></ChartAxisTitleStyle> </ChartPrimaryXAxis> <ChartPrimaryYAxis> <ChartStriplines> <ChartStripline Start="20" End="25" Color="red"> <ChartStriplineTextStyle Color="red"/> </ChartStripline> </ChartStriplines> </ChartPrimaryYAxis> <ChartCrosshairSettings Enable="true"></ChartCrosshairSettings> <ChartTooltipSettings Enable="true"> <ChartTooltipTextStyle Color="green"></ChartTooltipTextStyle> </ChartTooltipSettings> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@MedalDetails" Name="Gold" XName="Country" YName="Gold" Type="ChartSeriesType.Column"> <ChartMarker> <ChartDataLabel Visible="true"> <ChartDataLabelFont Color="yellow"></ChartDataLabelFont> </ChartDataLabel> </ChartMarker> </ChartSeries> </ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartLegendSettings Visible="true"> <ChartLegendTextStyle Color="blue"></ChartLegendTextStyle> </ChartLegendSettings> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDefaultFont.FontFamily
member.summary: Gets or sets the font family for the text.
member.value: A string representing the font family for the text. The default value is "Segoe UI".
member.remarks: This property specifies the font face used in rendering the text, offering a wide variety of standard and custom fonts.

example.code: // The following code demonstrates setting a custom font family for the text. <SfChart Title="Olympic Medals" SubTitle="In the year 2023"> <ChartTitleStyle FontFamily="Arial"></ChartTitleStyle> <ChartSubTitleStyle FontFamily="Arial"></ChartSubTitleStyle> <ChartPrimaryXAxis Title="Country" ValueType="Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ValueType.Category"> <ChartAxisCrosshairTooltip Enable="true"> <ChartCrosshairTextStyle FontFamily="Arial"></ChartCrosshairTextStyle> </ChartAxisCrosshairTooltip> <ChartAxisLabelStyle FontFamily="Arial"></ChartAxisLabelStyle> <ChartAxisTitleStyle FontFamily="Arial"></ChartAxisTitleStyle> </ChartPrimaryXAxis> <ChartPrimaryYAxis> <ChartStriplines> <ChartStripline Start="20" End="25" Color="red"> <ChartStriplineTextStyle FontFamily="Arial" /> </ChartStripline> </ChartStriplines> </ChartPrimaryYAxis> <ChartCrosshairSettings Enable="true"></ChartCrosshairSettings> <ChartTooltipSettings Enable="true"> <ChartTooltipTextStyle FontFamily="Arial"></ChartTooltipTextStyle> </ChartTooltipSettings> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@MedalDetails" Name="Gold" XName="Country" YName="Gold" Type="ChartSeriesType.Column"> <ChartMarker> <ChartDataLabel Visible="true"> <ChartDataLabelFont FontFamily="Arial"></ChartDataLabelFont> </ChartDataLabel> </ChartMarker> </ChartSeries> </ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartLegendSettings Visible="true"> <ChartLegendTextStyle FontFamily="Arial"></ChartLegendTextStyle> </ChartLegendSettings> </SfChart>

example.code: // The following code demonstrates setting a custom font style for the text. <SfChart Title="Olympic Medals" SubTitle="In the year 2023"> <ChartTitleStyle FontStyle="bold"></ChartTitleStyle> <ChartSubTitleStyle FontStyle="bold"></ChartSubTitleStyle> <ChartPrimaryXAxis Title="Country" ValueType="Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ValueType.Category"> <ChartAxisCrosshairTooltip Enable="true"> <ChartCrosshairTextStyle FontStyle="bold"></ChartCrosshairTextStyle> </ChartAxisCrosshairTooltip> <ChartAxisLabelStyle FontStyle="bold"></ChartAxisLabelStyle> <ChartAxisTitleStyle FontStyle="bold"></ChartAxisTitleStyle> </ChartPrimaryXAxis> <ChartPrimaryYAxis> <ChartStriplines> <ChartStripline Start="20" End="25" Color="red"> <ChartStriplineTextStyle FontStyle="bold"/> </ChartStripline> </ChartStriplines> </ChartPrimaryYAxis> <ChartCrosshairSettings Enable="true"></ChartCrosshairSettings> <ChartTooltipSettings Enable="true"> <ChartTooltipTextStyle FontStyle="bold"></ChartTooltipTextStyle> </ChartTooltipSettings> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@MedalDetails" Name="Gold" XName="Country" YName="Gold" Type="ChartSeriesType.Column"> <ChartMarker> <ChartDataLabel Visible="true"> <ChartDataLabelFont FontStyle="bold"></ChartDataLabelFont> </ChartDataLabel> </ChartMarker> </ChartSeries> </ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartLegendSettings Visible="true"> <ChartLegendTextStyle FontStyle="bold"></ChartLegendTextStyle> </ChartLegendSettings> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDefaultFont.FontWeight
member.summary: Gets or sets the font weight for the text.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDefaultFont.Opacity
member.summary: Gets or sets the opacity for the text.
member.value: A double value representing the opacity for the text. The default value is 1.
member.remarks: The opacity determines the transparency level of the text, where 1 is completely opaque, and 0 is fully transparent.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDefaultFont.Size
member.summary: Gets or sets the font size for the text.

example.code: // The following code demonstrates setting a custom font size for the text. <SfChart Title="Olympic Medals" SubTitle="In the year 2023"> <ChartTitleStyle Size="16px"></ChartTitleStyle> <ChartSubTitleStyle Size="16px"></ChartSubTitleStyle> <ChartPrimaryXAxis Title="Country" ValueType="Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ValueType.Category"> <ChartAxisCrosshairTooltip Enable="true"> <ChartCrosshairTextStyle Size="16px"></ChartCrosshairTextStyle> </ChartAxisCrosshairTooltip> <ChartAxisLabelStyle Size="13px"></ChartAxisLabelStyle> <ChartAxisTitleStyle Size="16px"></ChartAxisTitleStyle> </ChartPrimaryXAxis> <ChartPrimaryYAxis> <ChartStriplines> <ChartStripline Start="20" End="25" Color="red"> <ChartStriplineTextStyle Size="20px"/> </ChartStripline> </ChartStriplines> </ChartPrimaryYAxis> <ChartCrosshairSettings Enable="true"></ChartCrosshairSettings> <ChartTooltipSettings Enable="true"> <ChartTooltipTextStyle Size="16px"></ChartTooltipTextStyle> </ChartTooltipSettings> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@MedalDetails" Name="Gold" XName="Country" YName="Gold" Type="ChartSeriesType.Column"> <ChartMarker> <ChartDataLabel Visible="true"> <ChartDataLabelFont Size="16px"></ChartDataLabelFont> </ChartDataLabel> </ChartMarker> </ChartSeries> </ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartLegendSettings Visible="true"> <ChartLegendTextStyle Size="14px"></ChartLegendTextStyle> </ChartLegendSettings> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDefaultFont.TextAlignment
member.summary: Gets or sets the text alignment.
member.value:
One of the enumerations that specifies the alignment of the text. The options include:
Near - Aligns the text to the start of the container.
Far - Aligns the text to the far end of the container.
Center - Aligns the text to the center of the container.
The default value is Alignment.Center.
member.remarks: Text alignment adjusts the horizontal placement of text within its container, affecting its position relative to other content.

example.code: // The following code demonstrates setting a text alignment for the subtitle text. <SfChart Title="Olympic Medals" SubTitle="In the year 2023"> <ChartTitleStyle TextAlignment="Alignment.Far"></ChartTitleStyle> <ChartSubTitleStyle TextAlignment="Alignment.Far"></ChartSubTitleStyle> <ChartPrimaryXAxis Title="Country" ValueType="Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ValueType.Category"> <ChartAxisCrosshairTooltip Enable="true"> <ChartCrosshairTextStyle TextAlignment="Alignment.Far"></ChartCrosshairTextStyle> </ChartAxisCrosshairTooltip> <ChartAxisLabelStyle TextAlignment="Alignment.Far"></ChartAxisLabelStyle> <ChartAxisTitleStyle TextAlignment="Alignment.Far"></ChartAxisTitleStyle> </ChartPrimaryXAxis> <ChartPrimaryYAxis> <ChartStriplines> <ChartStripline Start="20" End="25" Color="red"> <ChartStriplineTextStyle TextAlignment="Alignment.Far"/> </ChartStripline> </ChartStriplines> </ChartPrimaryYAxis> <ChartCrosshairSettings Enable="true"></ChartCrosshairSettings> <ChartTooltipSettings Enable="true"> <ChartTooltipTextStyle TextAlignment="Alignment.Far"></ChartTooltipTextStyle> </ChartTooltipSettings> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@MedalDetails" Name="Gold" XName="Country" YName="Gold" Type="ChartSeriesType.Column"> <ChartMarker> <ChartDataLabel Visible="true"> <ChartDataLabelFont TextAlignment="Alignment.Far"></ChartDataLabelFont> </ChartDataLabel> </ChartMarker> </ChartSeries> </ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartLegendSettings Visible="true"> <ChartLegendTextStyle TextAlignment="Alignment.Far"></ChartLegendTextStyle> </ChartLegendSettings> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDefaultFont.TextOverflow
member.summary: Gets or sets the text overflow behavior to employ when the text exceeds the defined margins.
member.value:
One of the enumeration that specifies the text overflow options. The options include: - TextOverflow.Trim: Trims the text if it exceeds the defined margins. - TextOverflow.Wrap: Wraps the text if it exceeds the defined margins. - TextOverflow.None: Shows the text as it is.
The default value is TextOverflow.Trim.
member.remarks: This property manages how text should behave when it's too long for its allocated space, either by trimming, wrapping, or displaying fully.

example.code: // The following code demonstrates setting a text alignment for the subtitle text. <SfChart Title="Olympic Medals" SubTitle="In the year 2023"> <ChartTitleStyle TextOverflow="TextOverflow.None"></ChartTitleStyle> <ChartSubTitleStyle TextOverflow="TextOverflow.None"></ChartSubTitleStyle> <ChartPrimaryXAxis Title="Country" ValueType="Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ValueType.Category"> <ChartAxisCrosshairTooltip Enable="true"> <ChartCrosshairTextStyle TextOverflow="TextOverflow.None"></ChartCrosshairTextStyle> </ChartAxisCrosshairTooltip> <ChartAxisLabelStyle TextOverflow="TextOverflow.None"></ChartAxisLabelStyle> <ChartAxisTitleStyle TextOverflow="TextOverflow.None"></ChartAxisTitleStyle> </ChartPrimaryXAxis> <ChartPrimaryYAxis> <ChartStriplines> <ChartStripline Start="20" End="25" Color="red"> <ChartStriplineTextStyle TextOverflow="TextOverflow.None"/> </ChartStripline> </ChartStriplines> </ChartPrimaryYAxis> <ChartCrosshairSettings Enable="true"></ChartCrosshairSettings> <ChartTooltipSettings Enable="true"> <ChartTooltipTextStyle TextOverflow="TextOverflow.None"></ChartTooltipTextStyle> </ChartTooltipSettings> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@MedalDetails" Name="Gold" XName="Country" YName="Gold" Type="ChartSeriesType.Column"> <ChartMarker> <ChartDataLabel Visible="true"> <ChartDataLabelFont TextOverflow="TextOverflow.None"></ChartDataLabelFont> </ChartDataLabel> </ChartMarker> </ChartSeries> </ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartLegendSettings Visible="true"> <ChartLegendTextStyle TextOverflow="TextOverflow.None"></ChartLegendTextStyle> </ChartLegendSettings> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDefaultLocation.Y

member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDefaultMargin
member.summary: Provides the options for customizing the bottom, left, right, and top margins of the chart component.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDefaultMargin.Bottom
member.summary: Gets or sets the bottom margin for the chart component.
member.value: A representing the space in pixels added below the chart component. The default value is double.NaN.
member.remarks: Adjusting the bottom margin allows for additional space at the bottom of the chart, which is useful for accommodating labels or other elements that extend beyond the chart area.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDefaultMargin.Left
member.summary: Gets or sets the left margin for the chart component.
member.value: A representing the space in pixels added to the left of the chart component. The default value is double.NaN.
member.remarks: The left margin is primarily used to create buffer space on the left side, ideal for accommodating additional labels or annotations.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDefaultMargin.Right
member.summary: Gets or sets the right margin for the chart component.
member.value: A representing the space in pixels added to the right of the chart component. The default value is double.NaN.
member.remarks: Adjusting the right margin is often necessary to provide extra space for labels or other chart features that extend beyond the chart's immediate area.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDefaultMargin.Top
member.summary: Gets or sets the top margin for the chart component.
member.value: A representing the space in pixels added above the chart component. The default value is double.NaN.
member.remarks: The top margin is useful for creating space at the top of the chart to accommodate titles or legends that might otherwise overlap with chart data.

Specifies the possible positions for a scrollbar in a chart.
Available options: – Default. member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartIndicator
member.summary: Defines the technical indicator that is used in financial markets.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartIndicator.Type
member.summary: Gets or sets the type of the technical indicator.
member.value:
One of the enumerations that specifies the type of technical indicators. The options include: - Sma: Predicts the trend using a simple moving average approach. - Ema: Predicts the trend using an exponential moving average approach. - Tma: Predicts the trend using a triangle moving average approach. - Momentum: Predicts the trend using a momentum approach. - Atr: Predicts the trend using an average true range approach. - AccumulationDistribution: Predicts the trend using an accumulation distribution approach. - BollingerBands: Predicts the trend using a Bollinger approach. - Macd: Predicts the trend using moving average convergence divergence approach. - Stochastic: Predicts the trend using a stochastic approach. - Rsi: Predicts the trend using RSI approach.
The default value is TechnicalIndicators.Sma.
member.remarks: The property determines the algorithm used for trend prediction in the indicator.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to render a candlestick chart with an Accumulation/Distribution indicator. <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis ValueType="Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ValueType.DateTime" IntervalType="IntervalType.Months"> </ChartPrimaryXAxis> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@StockDetails" Name="Apple Inc" XName="X" Low="Low" High="High" Close="Close" Volume="Volume" Open="Open" Width="2" Type="ChartSeriesType.Candle"> </ChartSeries> </ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartIndicators> <ChartIndicator Type="TechnicalIndicators.AccumulationDistribution" SeriesName="Apple Inc" /> </ChartIndicators> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartIndicator.Period
member.summary: Gets or sets the period over which price changes will be considered to predict the trend.
member.value: A double representing the period. The default value is 14.
member.remarks: This property defines the time span over which price changes are taken into account for trend prediction. Adjusting this value can impact the sensitivity of trend analysis.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to render a period property in the chart indicator. <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis ValueType="Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ValueType.DateTime" IntervalType="IntervalType.Months"> </ChartPrimaryXAxis> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@StockDetails" Name="Apple Inc" XName="X" Low="Low" High="High" Close="Close" Volume="Volume" Open="Open" Type="ChartSeriesType.Candle" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartIndicators> <ChartIndicator Type="TechnicalIndicators.AccumulationDistribution" SeriesName="Apple Inc" Period="3" /> </ChartIndicators> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartIndicator.KPeriod
member.summary: Gets or sets the look-back period over which price changes will define the %K value in stochastic indicators.
member.value: A double representing the look-back period. The default value is 14.
member.remarks: This property determines the period over which price changes are considered to calculate the %K value in stochastic indicators.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to render a KPeriod property in the chart indicator. <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis ValueType="Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ValueType.DateTime" IntervalType="IntervalType.Months"> </ChartPrimaryXAxis> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@StockDetails" Name="Apple Inc" XName="X" Low="Low" High="High" Close="Close" Volume="Volume" Open="Open" Type="ChartSeriesType.Candle" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartIndicators> <ChartIndicator Type="TechnicalIndicators.Stochastic" SeriesName="Apple Inc" KPeriod="3" /> </ChartIndicators> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartIndicator.DPeriod
member.summary: Gets or sets the period over which price changes will define the %D value in stochastic indicators.
member.value: A double value representing the DPeriod value in stochastic indicators. The default value is 3.
member.remarks: This property determines the period over which price changes are considered to calculate the %D value in stochastic indicators.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to render a DPeriod property in the chart indicator. <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis ValueType="Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ValueType.DateTime" IntervalType="IntervalType.Months"> </ChartPrimaryXAxis> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@StockDetails" Name="Apple Inc" XName="X" Low="Low" High="High" Close="Close" Volume="Volume" Open="Open" Type="ChartSeriesType.Candle" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartIndicators> <ChartIndicator Type="TechnicalIndicators.Stochastic" SeriesName="Apple Inc" DPeriod="2" /> </ChartIndicators> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartIndicator.OverBought
member.summary: Gets or sets the over-bought (threshold) values.
member.value: A double representing the over-bought threshold values. The default value is 80.
member.remarks: This property is only applicable to RSI and stochastic indicators.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to render an OverBought property in the chart indicator. <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis ValueType="Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ValueType.DateTime" IntervalType="IntervalType.Months"> </ChartPrimaryXAxis> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@StockDetails" Name="Apple Inc" XName="X" Low="Low" High="High" Close="Close" Volume="Volume" Open="Open" Type="ChartSeriesType.Candle" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartIndicators> <ChartIndicator Type="TechnicalIndicators.Rsi" SeriesName="Apple Inc" KPeriod="3" OverBought="50" /> </ChartIndicators> </SfChart>

member.summary: Gets or sets the over-sold (threshold) values.
member.value: A double representing the over-sold threshold values. The default value is 20.
member.remarks: This property is only applicable to RSI and stochastic indicators.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to render an OverSold property in the chart indicator. <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis ValueType="Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ValueType.DateTime" IntervalType="IntervalType.Months"> </ChartPrimaryXAxis> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@StockDetails" Name="Apple Inc" XName="X" Low="Low" High="High" Close="Close" Volume="Volume" Open="Open" Type="ChartSeriesType.Candle" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartIndicators> <ChartIndicator Type="TechnicalIndicators.Rsi" SeriesName="Apple Inc" KPeriod="3" OverSold="50" /> </ChartIndicators> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartIndicator.StandardDeviation
member.summary: Gets or sets the standard deviation values used to define the upper and lower Bollinger Bands.
member.value: A double representing the standard deviation values. The default value is 2.
member.remarks: This property is applicable only for the Bollinger Bands indicator type. It determines the number of standard deviations to be used in calculating the upper and lower bands.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to render a StandardDeviation property in the chart indicator. <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis ValueType="Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ValueType.DateTime" IntervalType="IntervalType.Months"> </ChartPrimaryXAxis> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@StockDetails" Name="Apple Inc" XName="X" Low="Low" High="High" Close="Close" Volume="Volume" Open="Open" Type="ChartSeriesType.Candle" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartIndicators> <ChartIndicator Type="TechnicalIndicators.BollingerBands" SeriesName="Apple Inc" StandardDeviation="5" /> </ChartIndicators> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartIndicator.Field
member.summary: Gets or sets the field to compare the current value with previous values.
member.value:
One of the enumeration that specifies the financial data fields to compare the current value with previous values. The options include: - High: Defines the highest price in the stocks over time. - Low: Defines the lowest price in the stocks over time. - Open: Defines the opening price in the stocks over time. - Close: Defines the closing price in the stocks over time.
The default value is FinancialDataFields.Close.
member.remarks: This property is used to determine which aspect of financial data (e.g., high price, low price) the indicator should analyze against historical data.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to render a candlestick chart with a Bollinger Bands indicator using the 'High' field . <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis ValueType="Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ValueType.DateTime" IntervalType="IntervalType.Months"> </ChartPrimaryXAxis> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@StockDetails" Name="Apple Inc" XName="X" Low="Low" High="High" Close="Close" Volume="Volume" Open="Open" Type="ChartSeriesType.Candle" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartIndicators> <ChartIndicator Type="TechnicalIndicators.BollingerBands" Field="FinancialDataFields.High" SeriesName="Apple Inc" StandardDeviation="5" /> </ChartIndicators> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartIndicator.SlowPeriod
member.summary: Gets or sets the slow period used to define the MACD line.
member.value: A double representing the slow period for defining the MACD line. The default value is 12.
member.remarks: This property is applicable only for the MACD (Moving Average Convergence Divergence) indicator. It is used to customize the MACD period, influencing the calculation of the MACD line.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to render a candlestick chart with a MACD indicator, // using a slow period of 12 for the MACD calculation. <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis ValueType="Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ValueType.DateTime" IntervalType="IntervalType.Months"> </ChartPrimaryXAxis> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@StockDetails" Name="Apple Inc" XName="X" Low="Low" High="High" Close="Close" Volume="Volume" Open="Open" Type="ChartSeriesType.Candle" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartIndicators> <ChartIndicator Type="TechnicalIndicators.Macd" SeriesName="Apple Inc" SlowPeriod="12" /> </ChartIndicators> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartIndicator.FastPeriod
member.summary: Gets or sets the fast period used to define the MACD line.
member.value: A double representing the fast period for defining the MACD line. The default value is 26.
member.remarks: This property is applicable only for the MACD (Moving Average Convergence Divergence) indicator. It is used to customize the MACD period, influencing the calculation of the MACD line.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to render a candlestick chart with a MACD indicator, // using a slow period of 12 for the MACD calculation. <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis ValueType="Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ValueType.DateTime" IntervalType="IntervalType.Months"> </ChartPrimaryXAxis> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@StockDetails" Name="Apple Inc" XName="X" Low="Low" High="High" Close="Close" Volume="Volume" Open="Open" Type="ChartSeriesType.Candle" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartIndicators> <ChartIndicator Type="TechnicalIndicators.Macd" SeriesName="Apple Inc" FastPeriod="12" /> </ChartIndicators> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartIndicator.ShowZones
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether to show over-bought and over-sold regions.
member.value: true to show over-bought and over-sold regions; otherwise, false. The default value is true.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartIndicator.MacdType
member.summary: Gets or sets the type of the Macd indicator.
member.value: One of the enumeration that specifies the type of Macd indicator. The default value is MacdType.Both.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartLegendTextStyle.Size
member.summary: Gets or sets the font size for the legend text.
member.value: A string representing the font size for the legend text. The default font size for the legend text is 14px.
member.remarks: This property allows customization of how large or small the legend's text should appear.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to customize the legend text size in a chart. <SfChart> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@MedalDetails" Name="Gold" XName="Country" YName="Gold" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartLegendSettings Visible="true"> <ChartLegendTextStyle Size="14px" /> </ChartLegendSettings> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartLegendTextStyle.FontFamily
member.summary: Gets or sets the font family for the legend text.
member.value: A string representing the font family for the legend text. The default font family is determined by the chart's theme. By default, the theme is set to with the font family Roboto.
member.remarks: This property enables setting a specific font style for the legend text, allowing for better visual harmony with other theme elements.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to customize the legend text font family in a chart. <SfChart> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@MedalDetails" Name="Gold" XName="Country" YName="Gold" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartLegendSettings Visible="true"> <ChartLegendTextStyle FontFamily="Roboto" /> </ChartLegendSettings> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartLegendTextStyle.FontWeight
member.summary: Gets or sets the font weight for the legend text.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartLegendSettings.Position
member.summary: Gets or sets the position of the legend in the chart.
member.value:
One of the enumeration that specifies the position of the legend. The options include: - Auto: Places the legend based on based on width and height - Top : Displays the legend at the top of the chart. - Left : Displays the legend at the left of the chart. - Bottom: Displays the legend at the bottom of the chart. - Right: Displays the legend at the right of the chart. - Custom: Displays the legend based on the given x and y location values.
The default mode is LegendPosition.Auto.
member.remarks: Use this property to position the legend at the top, left, bottom, or right of the Accumulation Chart.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to set the legend position in a chart. <SfChart> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@MedalDetails" Name="Gold" XName="Country" YName="Gold" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartLegendSettings Visible="true" Position="LegendPosition.Top" /> </SfChart>

member.remarks: This property is used to adjust the space around the legend to enhance layout.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to adjust the space around the legend collection in a chart. <SfChart> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@MedalDetails" Name="Gold" XName="Country" YName="Gold" /> <ChartSeries DataSource="@MedalDetails" Name="Silver" XName="Country" YName="Silver" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartLegendSettings Visible="true" Padding="50" /> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartLegendSettings.ItemPadding
member.summary: Gets or sets the padding between legend items.
member.value: A double representing the padding between legend items. The default value is NaN.
member.remarks: This property provides the spacing between items in the legend.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to set the spacing between items in the legend of a chart. <SfChart> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@MedalDetails" Name="Gold" XName="Country" YName="Gold" /> <ChartSeries DataSource="@MedalDetails" Name="Silver" XName="Country" YName="Silver" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartLegendSettings Visible="true" ItemPadding="50" /> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartLegendSettings.Alignment
member.summary: Gets or sets the alignment of the legend.
member.value:
One of the enumerations that specifies the legend alignment. Options include: - Near: Aligns the legend to the left or top based on the . - Center: Aligns the legend to the center of the chart. - Far: Aligns the legend to the right or bottom based on the .
The default value is Alignment.Center.
member.remarks: The alignment of the legend works as follows: - Near: Aligns the legend to the top-left of the chart if is LegendPosition.Top and to the right-top of the chart if is LegendPosition.Right. - Center: Aligns the legend to the top center of the chart if is LegendPosition.Top and to the right center of the chart if is LegendPosition.Right. - Far: Aligns the legend to the top-right of the chart if is LegendPosition.Top and to the right-bottom of the chart if is LegendPosition.Right.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to set the alignment of the legend of a chart. <SfChart> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@MedalDetails" Name="Gold" XName="Country" YName="Gold" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartLegendSettings Visible="true" Alignment="Alignment.Far" /> </SfChart>

member.summary: Gets or sets the text overflow behavior to employ when the individual legend text overflows the legend bounds or .

One of the enumeration values that specifies the text overflow option. The options include: - LabelOverflow.Ellipse: Trims the text if it exceeds the defined margins. - TextOverflow.Clip: Shows the text as it is.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to render a column chart with rounded corners for top right corner. <SfChart> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@Data" XName="XValue" YName="YValue" Type="ChartSeriesType.Column"> <ChartCornerRadius TopRight="20" /> </ChartSeries> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartSeries
member.summary: Defines the options for a series in a chart, allowing customization of its appearance and behavior.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartSeries.Type
member.summary: Specifies the type of series, such as Line, Column, Area, and others.
member.value: An enumeration of type representing the series type.
member.remarks: The type of the series affects how the data is rendered in the chart. Note: Need to assigned the DataSource, XName, YName properties.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to render a line chart type in a chart. <SfChart> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@Data" XName="XValue" YName="YValue" Type="ChartSeriesType.Line" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartSeries.Visible
member.summary: Specifies the visibility of the series.
member.value: A boolean value indicating whether the series is visible or not. The default is true.
member.remarks: Use the property to toggle the display of the series on the chart.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to hide a chart series using the 'Visible' property. <SfChart> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@Data" XName="XValue" YName="YValue" Visible="false" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartSeries.Width
member.summary: Defines the stroke width for the series, applicable to series of Line type. Also represents the stroke width of signal lines in technical indicators.
member.value: A double value specifying the width of the line strokes in pixels.
member.remarks: This property is applicable for line-type series.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to set the width of a chart series. <SfChart> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@Data" XName="XValue" YName="YValue" Width="20" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartSeries.XAxisName
member.summary: Specifies the name of the horizontal axis associated with the series.
member.value: A string representing the name of the associated horizontal axis. Default is "PrimaryXAxis".
member.remarks: This property is used when associating the series with an axis.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to assign secondary x axis to the chart series. <SfChart> <ChartAxes> <ChartAxis Name="XAxis" /> </ChartAxes> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y" /> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y1" XAxisName="XAxis" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartSeries.AccessibilityDescription
member.summary: Gets or sets the accessibility description for the .
member.value: Accepts a string that defines the accessibility description for the . The default value is null.
member.remarks: Use this property to provide an accessibility description for the root element, which is the parent element of the series points.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to set the accessibility description for a chart series. <SfChart> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@Data" XName="XValue" YName="YValue" AccessibilityDescription="This is a sample series" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartSeries.AccessibilityDescriptionFormat
member.summary:
Gets or sets the format string used for the accessibility description of the data points in the . The format string can include the following placeholders:
${series.name}: Displays the name of the series.
${point.x}: Displays the x-value of the point.
${point.y}: Displays the y-value of the point.
${point.high}: Displays the high value of the point. This is applicable only for financial and range series.
${point.low}: Displays the low value of the point. This is applicable only for financial and range series.
${point.open}: Displays the open value of the point. This is applicable only for financial series.
${point.close}: Displays the close value of the point. This is applicable only for financial series.
member.value: A string that specifies the format for the accessibility description of points in the series.
member.remarks: Use this property to specify the format for the points accessibility description of the . The property provides accessibility information for the series root element. However, this property allows you to provide dynamic information based on the data. For example, the format "${series.name} : ${point.x}" displays the series name and x-value of the point in the accessibility description.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to set the accessibility description format for a chart series. <SfChart> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@Data" XName="XValue" YName="YValue" AccessibilityDescriptionFormat="${series.name} : ${point.x}" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartSeries.AccessibilityRole
member.summary: Gets or sets the accessibility role for the .
member.value: Accepts a string that defines the accessibility role for the . The default value is null.
member.remarks: Use this property to specify the accessibility role for the root element.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to set the accessibility role for a chart series. <SfChart> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@Data" XName="XValue" YName="YValue" AccessibilityRole="region" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartSeries.Focusable
member.summary: Gets or sets the accessibility keyboard navigation focus option for the .
member.value: Accepts a boolean value to enable or disable keyboard navigation for the . The default value is true.
member.remarks: Use this property to toggle keyboard navigation focus for the .

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to enable focusable behavior on a chart series. <SfChart> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@Data" XName="XValue" YName="YValue" Focusable="true" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartSeries.XName
member.summary: Gets or sets the field name in the data source that represents the x-axis value.
member.value: A string specifying the data source field for the x-axis value.
member.remarks: This property is applicable to both series and technical indicators, determining how data points are bound to the x-axis in the chart.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to bind a field from for data source to X axis. <SfChart> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@Data" XName="XValue" YName="YValue" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartSeries.YAxisName
member.summary: Gets or sets the name of the vertical axis associated with the series.
member.value: A string representing the name of the associated vertical axis. The default value is "PrimaryYAxis".
member.remarks: Use this property to link the series to a specific vertical axis, allowing for targeted data plotting on the chart. It is applicable for series and technical indicators. It requires Axes of the chart.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to assign secondary y axis to the chart series. <SfChart> <ChartAxes> <ChartAxis Name="YAxis" /> </ChartAxes> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y" /> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y1" YAxisName="YAxis" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartSeries.YName
member.summary: Gets or sets the field name in the data source that represents the y-axis value.
member.value: A string specifying the data source field for the y-axis value.
member.remarks: This property is used to map data points to the y-axis.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to bind a field from for data source to y axis. <SfChart> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@Data" XName="XValue" YName="YValue" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartSeries.Low

member.remarks: This property is utilized in financial charts to identify the low points of data entries, such as those in stock market data.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to render a HiloOpenClose series in a chart using the Low property. <SfChart> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@StockDetails" XName="X" High="High" Low="Low" Open="Open" Close="Close" Type="ChartSeriesType.HiloOpenClose"> </ChartSeries> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartSeries.GroupName

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to use grouped column series in a Chart. <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis ValueType="@Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ValueType.Category" Interval="1"> </ChartPrimaryXAxis> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@ChartPoints" XName="Year" YName="USA_Total" GroupName="USA" Type="ChartSeriesType.Column" /> <ChartSeries DataSource="@ChartPoints" XName="Year" YName="USA_Gold" GroupName="USA" Type="ChartSeriesType.Column" /> <ChartSeries DataSource="@ChartPoints" XName="Year" YName="UK_Total" GroupName="UK" Type="ChartSeriesType.Column" /> <ChartSeries DataSource="@ChartPoints" XName="Year" YName="UK_Gold" GroupName="UK" Type="ChartSeriesType.Column" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

example.code:
// This example demonstrates how to render a candlestick chart with an Accumulation/Distribution indicator. <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis ValueType="Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ValueType.DateTime" Title="months" IntervalType="IntervalType.Months"> </ChartPrimaryXAxis>
<ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@StockDetails" Name="Apple Inc" XName="X" Low="Low" High="High" Close="Close" Volume="Volume" Open="Open" Width="2" Type="ChartSeriesType.Candle"> </ChartSeries> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartSeries.EnableTooltip
member.summary: If set to true, the tooltip for the series will be visible.
member.value: A boolean indicating whether tooltips are enabled for the series. The default is true.
member.remarks: Use this property to display additional information about series points when hovering over them with cursor. Note: This property is applicable only when the ChartTooltipSettings.Enable property is set to true.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to disable the tooltip for a chart series. <SfChart> <ChartTooltipSettings Enable="true"></ChartTooltipSettings> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@Data" XName="XValue" YName="YValue" EnableTooltip="false" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartSeries.ShowNearestTooltip
member.summary: Gets or sets a value that determines whether tooltips are displayed for the nearest data point to the cursor for a specific chart series.
member.value: true to display the tooltip for the nearest data point to the cursor on the specific chart series; otherwise, false. The default value is true.
member.remarks: This property controls the display of the tooltip based on the proximity of the nearest data point to the cursor for a specific chart series. The ChartTooltipSettings.ShowNearestTooltip property must be set to true for this property to function. When the ChartSeries.ShowNearestTooltip property is set to false, the tooltip for the nearest data point will not be displayed for the current series, but it may still be shown for other series.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to enable and show the nearest tooltip on both the chart and series. <SfChart> <ChartTooltipSettings Enable="true" ShowNearestTooltip="true"></ChartTooltipSettings> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@Data" XName="XValue" YName="YValue" ShowNearestTooltip="true" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to enable tooltip with custom format. <SfChart> <ChartTooltipSettings Enable="true"></ChartTooltipSettings> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@Data" XName="XValue" YName="YValue" TooltipFormat="${point.x}" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDataLabel
member.summary: Provides options to customize the data label for the series.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDataLabel.Visible
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the data label is visible.
member.value: A boolean value is accepted. Set to true to enable the data label; otherwise, false. The default value is false.
member.remarks: Use the property to control the visibility of data labels in the Chart series.

example.code: // The following example demonstrates how to enable data labels in the chart: <SfChart> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y"> <ChartMarker> <ChartDataLabel Visible="true"/> </ChartMarker> </ChartSeries> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDataLabel.Name
member.summary: Gets or sets the name used for data label mapping in the Chart series.
member.value: A string representing the mapping name of the data label. The default value is null.
member.remarks: Use the property to specify the field name in the data source that should be used for data label mapping in the chart series. When this property is set, the chart will use the specified field values as data labels for the corresponding data points.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDataLabel.Format
member.summary: Gets or sets the format for the data label text.
member.value: A string specifying the format of the data label. The default value is null.
member.remarks: Use the property to define the format for the data labels in the Chart series. You can use standard string format specifiers like 'C' for currency, 'P' for percentage, 'N1' for numeric format with one decimal place, etc. Additionally, you can use placeholders like '{value}' in the format string to dynamically represent the data label value.

example.code: // The following example demonstrates how to format the data label using currency format: <SfChart> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y"> <ChartMarker> <ChartDataLabel Visible="true" Format="{value}°C"/> </ChartMarker> </ChartSeries> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDataLabel.Fill
member.summary: Gets or sets the fill color of the datalabel.
member.value: Accepts valid CSS color string values such as hexadecimal, rgba, and color names. The default value is transparent.
member.remarks: The fill color is used to set the background color of the data label.

example.code: // The following example demonstrates setting a fill color for the data label background: <SfChart> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y"> <ChartMarker> <ChartDataLabel Visible="true" Fill="#1b49cc"/> </ChartMarker> </ChartSeries> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDataLabel.Opacity
member.summary: Gets or sets the opacity of the datalabel.
member.value: A double representing the opacity level of the data label. Possible values range from 0 to 1. The default value is 1.
member.remarks: This property specifies the transparency level of the data label background.

example.code: // This example demonstrates setting the opacity of a data label to 0.2: <SfChart> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y"> <ChartMarker> <ChartDataLabel Visible="true" Fill="#1b49cc" Opacity="0.2"/> </ChartMarker> </ChartSeries> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDataLabel.Angle
member.summary: Gets or sets the angle for rotating the data labels in the Chart.
member.value: Accepts a double value ranging from -360 to 360, representing the angle in degrees. The default value is 0.
member.remarks: When this property is set to a negative value, the data label will rotate in an anti-clockwise direction. This property is effective only when is enabled.

example.code: // The following example demonstrates setting the rotation angle of data labels to 90 degrees: <SfChart> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y"> <ChartMarker> <ChartDataLabel Visible="true" EnableRotation="true" Angle="90"/> </ChartMarker> </ChartSeries> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDataLabel.EnableRotation
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether rotation is enabled for the data label in the Chart series.
member.value: A boolean indicating if the rotation is enabled. The default value is false.
member.remarks: When the property is set to true, data labels will be rotated based on the specified angle.

example.code: // The following code demonstrates how to enable rotation for data labels in an chart component: <SfChart> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y"> <ChartMarker> <ChartDataLabel Visible="true" EnableRotation="true" Angle="90"/> </ChartMarker> </ChartSeries> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDataLabel.Position
member.summary: Gets or sets the position of the data labels.
member.value:
One of the enumerations that determines the placement of the data label relative to the data points. Position options include: - Outer: Positions the label outside the data point. - Top: Positions the label on top of the data point. - Bottom: Positions the label at the bottom of the data point. - Middle: Positions the label in the middle of the data point. - Auto: Automatically positions the label based on the series settings.
The default value is LabelPosition.Auto.
member.remarks: The position of the data labels determines where they are displayed relative to the data points in the Chart series.

example.code: // The following example demonstrates setting the position of data labels: <SfChart> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y" Type="ChartSeriesType.Column"> <ChartMarker> <ChartDataLabel Visible="true" Position="LabelPosition.Outer"></ChartDataLabel> </ChartMarker> </ChartSeries> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDataLabel.Rx
member.summary: Gets or sets the horizontal radius of the rounded corners of the data label.
member.value: A double value representing the horizontal width of the rounded corner. The default value is 5.
member.remarks: This property affects the appearance of the corners of the data label's background. This property is applicable only when is enabled.

example.code: // The following example demonstrates setting a horizontal radius for the data label corners: <SfChart> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y"> <ChartMarker> <ChartDataLabel Visible="true" Rx="10"> <ChartDataLabelBorder Width="1" Color="black"></ChartDataLabelBorder> </ChartDataLabel> </ChartMarker> </ChartSeries> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDataLabel.Ry
member.summary: Gets or sets the vertical radius of the rounded corners of the data label.
member.value: A double value representing the vertical width of the rounded corner. The default value is 5.
member.remarks: This property affects the appearance of the corners of the data label's background. This property is applicable only when is enabled.

example.code: // The following example demonstrates setting a horizontal radius for the data label corners: <SfChart> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y"> <ChartMarker> <ChartDataLabel Visible="true" Ry="10"> <ChartDataLabelBorder Width="1" Color="black"></ChartDataLabelBorder> </ChartDataLabel> </ChartMarker> </ChartSeries> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDataLabel.Alignment
member.summary: Gets or sets the alignment for the data labels.
member.value:
One of the enumerations that determines the position of the datalabel. Alignment options include: - Near: Positions the data label to the right of the data points. - Center: Centers the data label directly over the data points. - Far: Places the data label to the left of the data points.
The default value is Alignment.Center.
member.remarks: This property sets the alignment of data labels in relation to the data points on a chart, allowing them to appear to the left, right, or center of the point.

example.code: // The following example demonstrates setting the alignment of data labels: <SfChart> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y" Type="ChartSeriesType.Column"> <ChartMarker> <ChartDataLabel Visible="true" Alignment="Alignment.Near"></ChartDataLabel> </ChartMarker> </ChartSeries> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDataLabel.Border
member.summary: Gets or sets the options to customize the border of the data label.
member.value: Accepts the instance of the class. The default value is a new instance of the class.
member.remarks: Use this property to customize the border of data labels in the Chart series.

example.code: // The following example demonstrates setting a custom border for data labels: <SfChart> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y" Type="ChartSeriesType.Bar"> <ChartMarker> <ChartDataLabel Visible="true"> <ChartDataLabelBorder Width="2" Color="blue"></ChartDataLabelBorder> </ChartDataLabel> </ChartMarker> </ChartSeries> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDataLabel.Margin
member.summary: Gets or sets the options to customize the margin for the data labels in the chart series.
member.value: Accepts the instance of the class. The default value is a new instance of the class with all margins set to 5.
member.remarks: This property allows customization of the space surrounding the data label within a chart, including the series. It is particularly useful when the is enabled.

example.code: // The following code snippet demonstrates setting custom margins for the data labels: <SfChart> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y"> <ChartMarker> <ChartDataLabel Visible="true"> <ChartDataLabelBorder Width="1" Color="black"></ChartDataLabelBorder> <ChartDataLabelMargin Top="10" Bottom="10" Left="10" Right="10"></ChartDataLabelMargin> </ChartDataLabel> </ChartMarker> </ChartSeries> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDataLabel.Font
member.summary: Gets or sets the options to customize the font of the data labels for the Chart series.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDataLabel.LabelIntersectAction
member.summary: Gets or sets the action for data label intersection.
member.value:
A string representing the action to be taken when data labels intersect. The options include: - Hide: Data labels that intersect will not be displayed. - Trim: Data labels will be truncated to fit without intersection. - None: No action is taken, labels will overlap if necessary.
The default value is Hide.
member.remarks: This property determines how overlapping data labels are managed on the chart.

example.code: // The following example demonstrates setting the action for data label intersection: <SfChart> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y" Type="ChartSeriesType.Pie"> <ChartMarker> <ChartDataLabel Visible="true" LabelIntersectAction="Trim"></ChartDataLabel> </ChartMarker> </ChartSeries> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartEmptyPointSettings
member.summary: Provides the options to customize the empty point of the chart.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartEmptyPointSettings.Mode
member.summary: Gets or sets the mode for handling empty points in the series.
member.value: An enumeration value that indicates how empty points are treated in the chart. Options include: - Gap: Leaves a gap for empty points. - Zero: Renders empty points as zero. - Average: Uses the average of adjacent points for empty points. - Drop: Drops empty points from the chart. The default value is .
member.remarks: This property determines how the chart visually represents data points that are missing or explicitly set to be empty. Use the property to control how empty points are rendered. Data points with NaN or null values are treated as empty points.

member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartLastDataLabel
member.summary: Defines the options for customizing and displaying the label of the last value in the series.
member.remarks: This property allows you to display a label for the last value in a series, with customizable appearance options such as background color, line color, and dash pattern.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartLastDataLabel.ShowLabel
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the label and indicator for the last data point in the series are visible.
member.value: true to display the last value label and the corresponding grid line indicator; otherwise, false. The default value is false.

example.code: <SfChart> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries XName="X" YName="Y" DataSource="@StockData" Type="ChartSeriesType.Line"> <ChartLastDataLabel ShowLabel="true" /> </ChartSeries> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.remarks: Use this property to toggle the visibility of the last data label in the chart series. This is particularly useful for highlighting trend endpoints or enhancing visual clarity in analytical charts.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartLastDataLabel.Background
member.summary: Gets or sets the background color of the last value label.
member.value: A string representing the background color (e.g., "#ffffff" or "transparent"). The default value is "transparent".

example.code: <SfChart> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries XName="X" YName="Y" DataSource="@StockData" Type="ChartSeriesType.Line"> <ChartLastDataLabel ShowLabel="true" Background="red" /> </ChartSeries> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.remarks: Useful for enhancing label visibility, especially when the chart background contains multiple colors.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartLastDataLabel.DashArray
member.summary: Gets or sets the dash pattern for the grid line behind the last value label.
member.value: A string defining the dash array (e.g., "4,2" for dashed lines). The default value is an empty string, which results in a solid line.

example.code: <SfChart> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries XName="X" YName="Y" DataSource="@StockData" Type="ChartSeriesType.Line"> <ChartLastDataLabel ShowLabel="true" DashArray="2,5" /> </ChartSeries> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.remarks: This property is useful for distinguishing the indicator line from other grid lines or series lines.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartLastDataLabel.LineWidth
member.summary: Gets or sets the width of the line displayed behind the last value label.
member.value: A double value specifying the thickness of the grid line. The default value is 1.

example.code: <SfChart> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries XName="X" YName="Y" DataSource="@StockData" Type="ChartSeriesType.Line"> <ChartLastDataLabel ShowLabel="true" LineWidth="0.5" /> </ChartSeries> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.remarks: Thicker lines can improve visibility, especially when multiple series are present.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartLastDataLabel.LineColor
member.summary: Gets or sets the color of the grid line displayed behind the last value label.
member.value: A string specifying the grid line color. The default value is an empty string, which means the series color will be used.

example.code: <SfChart> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries XName="X" YName="Y" DataSource="@StockData" Type="ChartSeriesType.Line"> <ChartLastDataLabel ShowLabel="true" LineColor="black" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </ChartSeries> </SfChart>

member.remarks: This property helps provide a direct reference line across the chart to the last value, improving readability and data interpretation.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartLastDataLabel.Rx
member.summary: Gets or sets the horizontal radius of the rounded corners of the last data label.

member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartSorting
member.summary: Configures the sorting option for the chart.
member.example:
This example shows how to sort a chart by the "Y" property in asscending order.
<SfChart @ref=”Chart” DataSource=”Data”> <ChartSorting PropertyName ="Y" Direction ="SortDirection.Descending"/> … </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartSorting.Parent
member.summary: Specifies the direction in which to sort the chart data.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartSorting.Direction
member.summary:
Get and set the sorting direction for the chart data. The available direction are,
Ascending Sort from smallest to largest. For example, from A to Z.
Descending Sort from largest to smallest. For example, from Z to A.
member.value:
An that specifies the sort order for the chart data. The possible values are:
Ascending: Sorts the chart data from smallest value to largest.
Descending: Sorts the chart data from largest value to smallest.
The default value is .
member.remarks: This property is essential for defining the sorting behavior of the chart data.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to sort the chart data in descending order based on the X axis values. <SfChart> <ChartSorting PropertyName="X" Direction="ListSortDirection.Descending"></ChartSorting> <ChartPrimaryXAxis ValueType="Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ValueType.Category" /> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@SalesReports" XName="X" YName="YValue" Type="ChartSeriesType.Column"></ChartSeries> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartSorting.PropertyName
member.summary: Gets or sets the property name being used as the sorting criterion.
member.value: A string specifying the property name for sorting, such as x, y, high, low, open, close, or size fields of the chart data source. The default value is null.
member.remarks: This property determines the field by which the chart data should be sorted.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to sort the chart data in ascending order based on the X axis values. <SfChart> <ChartSorting PropertyName="X" Direction="ListSortDirection.Descending"></ChartSorting> <ChartPrimaryXAxis ValueType="Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ValueType.Category" /> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@SalesReports" XName="X" YName="YValue" Type="ChartSeriesType.Column"></ChartSeries> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.SfChart.SelectionMode
member.summary: Gets or sets the selection mode of the chart component.
member.value:
One of the enumerations that specifies the selection mode of the chart component. The options include: - None: No selection will occur. - Series: Selects a series. - Point: Selects a single point. - Cluster: Selects the points in all series that correspond to the same index.
The default value is SelectionMode.None.
member.remarks: This property determines how the user can select elements within the chart, which can enhance user interaction and data analysis.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to enable drag-to-select functionality in a Syncfusion Blazor Chart. <SfChart SelectionMode="SelectionMode.DragXY"> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y" Type="ChartSeriesType.Column" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.SfChart.HighlightMode
member.summary: Gets or sets the highlight mode of the chart component.
member.value:
One of the enumeration that specifies the highlight mode of the chart component. The options include: - None: No highlighting will occur. - Series: Series will be highlighted when hovered. - Point: Point will be highlighted when hovered. - Cluster: A cluster of points in all series that correspond to the same index will be highlighted when hovered.
The default value is HighlightMode.None.
member.remarks: This property determines how the chart elements will be highlighted based on user interaction, enhancing the visual feedback during data exploration.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to enable series highlighting in a Syncfusion Blazor Chart. <SfChart HighlightColor="true" HighlightMode="HighlightMode.Series"> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y" Type="ChartSeriesType.Column" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.SfChart.EnableAdaptiveRendering
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether adaptive rendering is enabled for the Chart component.
member.value: A boolean value that enables or disables adaptive rendering for the Chart component. The default value is false.

member.name: M:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.SfChart.ClearSelection
member.summary: Clears the selection applied to the chart.

example.code:
<SfButton OnClick="ClearSelection" IsToggle="true" IsPrimary="true">ClearSelection</SfButton>
            <SfChart @ref ="Chart">
               <ChartSelectedDataIndexes>
                   @foreach(SelectedDataPoint data in SelectionData)
                   {
                       <ChartSelectedDataIndex Series="@data.seriesIndex" Point="@data.pointIndex">
                       </ChartSelectedDataIndex>
                   }
               </ChartSelectedDataIndexes>
               ...
            </SfChart>
            @code
            {
               public SfChart Chart;
               public List<SelectedDataPoint> SelectionData = new List<SelectedDataPoint>
               {
                   new SelectedDataPoint { seriesIndex = 0, pointIndex = 1 },
                   new SelectedDataPoint { seriesIndex = 1, pointIndex = 3 }
               };
               public class SelectedDataPoint
               {
                   public int seriesIndex { get; set; }
                   public int pointIndex { get; set; }
               }
               public void ClearSelection()
               {
                   Chart.ClearSelection();
               }
            }

member.remarks: This method clears all selections applied to the chart for all types of .

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartStackLabelSettings.Format
