member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDataEditSettings
member.summary: Provides options to customize the drag settings for chart series.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDataEditSettings.Enable
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether to enable data editing by dragging the point.
member.value: true if data editing is enabled; otherwise, false. The default value is false.
member.remarks: When set to true, users can interactively edit data points by dragging them on the chart.

example.code: // This example shows how to enable data editing in a chart by setting the ChartDataEditSettings. <SfChart> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@Data" Name="England" XName="XValue" YName="YValue"> <ChartDataEditSettings Enable="true"></ChartDataEditSettings> <ChartMarker Visible="true" Width="10" Height="10" /> </ChartSeries> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDataEditSettings.Fill
member.summary: Gets or sets the color for the edited point.
member.value: A string representing the color of the edited point.
member.remarks:
The property specifies the color of the point interior which will be assigned while dragging and will remain for the edited point. This property accepts values in hex or rgba as a valid CSS color string.
Note: It is not applicable to line-based series types such as Line, Step Line, and Spline.

example.code: // This example demonstrates enabling data editing in a column chart and setting the fill color of edited points. <SfChart> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@Data" Name="England" XName="XValue" YName="YValue" Type="ChartSeriesType.Column"> <ChartDataEditSettings Enable="true" Fill="red"></ChartDataEditSettings> <ChartMarker Visible="true" Width="10" Height="10" /> </ChartSeries> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDataEditSettings.MaxY
member.summary: Gets or sets the maximum Y value to which the point can be dragged for data editing.
member.value: Accepts double value. The default value is .
member.remarks: This property helps control the upper limit for the Y-axis when interactively editing data points on the chart.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to enable data editing in a column chart // and limit the maximum editable Y-value to 20 using MaxY property. <SfChart> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@Data" Name="England" XName="XValue" YName="YValue" Type="ChartSeriesType.Column"> <ChartDataEditSettings Enable="true" MaxY="20"></ChartDataEditSettings> <ChartMarker Visible="true" Width="10" Height="10" /> </ChartSeries> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDataEditSettings.MinY
member.summary: Gets or sets the minimum Y value to which the point can be dragged for data editing.
member.value: Accepts double value. The default value is .
member.remarks: This property helps control the lower limit for the Y-axis when interactively editing data points on the chart.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to enable data editing in a column chart // and restrict the minimum editable Y-value to 30 using the MinY property. <SfChart> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@Data" Name="England" XName="XValue" YName="YValue" Type="ChartSeriesType.Column"> <ChartDataEditSettings Enable="true" MinY="30"></ChartDataEditSettings> <ChartMarker Visible="true" Width="10" Height="10" /> </ChartSeries> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartZoomSettings
member.summary: Provides options to customize the zoom settings of the chart.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartZoomSettings.EnableDeferredZooming
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether to update the chart with a delay while panning.
member.value: true if updating the chart with a delay while panning is enabled; otherwise, false. The default value is true.
member.remarks: Enabling this option can provide a smoother user experience during panning by introducing a delay before the chart is updated.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to enable selection zooming with deferred zooming in a chart. <SfChart> <ChartZoomSettings EnableDeferredZooming="true" EnableSelectionZooming="true" /> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@Data" Name="England" XName="XValue" YName="YValue"> <ChartMarker Visible="true" Width="10" Height="10" /> </ChartSeries> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartZoomSettings.EnableMouseWheelZooming
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the chart can be zoomed using the mouse wheel.
member.value: true if the chart can be zoomed using the mouse wheel; otherwise, false. The default value is false.
member.remarks: Enabling this option allows users to zoom in or out on the chart by using the mouse wheel.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to enable mouse wheel zooming in a chart. <SfChart> <ChartZoomSettings EnableMouseWheelZooming="true" /> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@Data" Name="England" XName="XValue" YName="YValue"> <ChartMarker Visible="true" Width="10" Height="10" /> </ChartSeries> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartZoomSettings.EnablePan
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the chart can be panned when zoomed.
member.value: true if the chart can be panned when zoomed; otherwise, false. The default value is false.
member.remarks: Enabling this option allows users to pan across the zoomed-in chart area for better exploration of specific regions.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to enable pan functionality in a chart. <SfChart> <ChartZoomSettings EnablePan="true" /> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@Data" Name="England" XName="XValue" YName="YValue"> <ChartMarker Visible="true" Width="10" Height="10" /> </ChartSeries> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartZoomSettings.EnablePinchZooming
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the chart can be zoomed through pinch gestures on touch-enabled devices.
member.value: true if the chart can be zoomed through pinch gestures; otherwise, false. The default value is false.
member.remarks: Enabling this option allows users to zoom in or zoom out on the chart by performing pinch gestures on touch-enabled devices.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to enable pinch zooming in a chart. <SfChart> <ChartZoomSettings EnablePinchZooming="true" /> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@Data" Name="England" XName="XValue" YName="YValue"> <ChartMarker Visible="true" Width="10" Height="10" /> </ChartSeries> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartZoomSettings.EnableScrollbar
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the axis should have a scrollbar when zoomed.
member.value: true if the axis should have a scrollbar when zoomed; otherwise, false. The default value is false.
member.remarks: Enabling this option allows users to navigate and visualize specific regions of the chart using scrollbar when zoomed.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to enable the scrollbar in a chart. <SfChart> <ChartZoomSettings EnableScrollbar="true" ToolbarDisplayMode="ToolbarMode.Always" /> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@Data" Name="England" XName="XValue" YName="YValue"> <ChartMarker Visible="true" Width="10" Height="10" /> </ChartSeries> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartZoomSettings.EnableSelectionZooming
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the chart can be zoomed by selecting a rectangular region on the plot area.
member.value: true if the chart can be zoomed by selecting a rectangular region on the plot area; otherwise, false. The default value is false.
member.remarks: Enabling this option provides an interactive way for users to focus on specific areas of interest within the chart.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to enable selection zooming in a chart. <SfChart> <ChartZoomSettings EnableSelectionZooming="true" ToolbarDisplayMode="ToolbarMode.Always" /> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@Data" Name="England" XName="XValue" YName="YValue"> <ChartMarker Visible="true" Width="10" Height="10" /> </ChartSeries> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartZoomSettings.Mode
member.summary: Gets or sets the mode of zooming.
member.value:
One of the enumeration that specifies the mode of zooming. The options include: - XY: Chart can be zoomed both vertically and horizontally. - X: Chart can be zoomed horizontally. - Y: Chart can be zoomed vertically.
The default mode is ZoomMode.XY.
member.remarks: This property can be set to allow zooming both vertically and horizontally, only horizontally, or only vertically.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to enable zooming only along the Y-axis in a chart. <SfChart> <ChartZoomSettings Mode="ZoomMode.Y" ToolbarDisplayMode="ToolbarMode.Always" /> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@Data" Name="England" XName="XValue" YName="YValue"> <ChartMarker Visible="true" Width="10" Height="10" /> </ChartSeries> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartZoomSettings.ToolbarDisplayMode
member.summary: Gets or sets the visibility mode for the zooming toolbar in the chart.
member.value:
One of the enumeration that specifies the visibility mode for the zooming toolbar. The options include: - OnDemand: The zooming toolbar is only visible while the chart has zoomed. - Always: The zooming toolbar is always visible even though the chart has not zoomed. - None: The zooming toolbar will not be visible even though the chart is zoomed.
The default value is ToolbarMode.OnDemand.
member.remarks: It determines whether the toolbar should be visible only when the chart is zoomed, always visible, or never visible.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to display the zoom toolbar always in a chart. <SfChart> <ChartZoomSettings ToolbarDisplayMode="ToolbarMode.Always" /> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@Data" Name="England" XName="XValue" YName="YValue"> <ChartMarker Visible="true" Width="10" Height="10" /> </ChartSeries> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartZoomSettings.ToolbarItems
member.summary: Gets or sets the list of items to be added in the toolbar for the chart.
member.value: The list of to be displayed in the chart toolbar. The available items include: - Zoom - ZoomIn - ZoomOut - Pan - Reset
member.remarks: The property allows customization of the items displayed in the chart toolbar. Users can choose from a set of predefined items, such as Zoom, ZoomIn, ZoomOut, Pan, and Reset, to be included in the toolbar.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to configure specific toolbar items in a chart's zoom settings. <SfChart> <ChartZoomSettings ToolbarDisplayMode="ToolbarMode.Always" ToolbarItems="new List<ToolbarItems>() { ToolbarItems.Zoom, ToolbarItems.Reset, ToolbarItems.Pan }" /> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@Data" Name="England" XName="XValue" YName="YValue"> <ChartMarker Visible="true" Width="10" Height="10" /> </ChartSeries> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartZoomSettings.AccessibilityDescriptionFormat
member.summary: Gets or sets the format for the toolkit accessibility description of the chart zoom toolkit.
member.value: Accepts a string that defines the format for the toolkit accessibility description of the chart zoom toolkit. The default value is null.
member.remarks: Use this property to specify a format for the toolkit accessibility description of the chart zoom toolkit. The placeholder ${value} can be used to set the accessibility text for the zoom toolkit toolbar item name. For example, the format "Selected the ${value} option" will read as "Selected the ZoomIn option" for the button.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to configure the accessibility description format for the toolbar items in a chart's zoom settings. <SfChart> <ChartZoomSettings ToolbarDisplayMode="ToolbarMode.Always" AccessibilityDescriptionFormat="Selected the ${value} option" /> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@Data" Name="England" XName="XValue" YName="YValue"> <ChartMarker Visible="true" Width="10" Height="10" /> </ChartSeries> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartZoomSettings.AccessibilityRole
member.summary: Gets or sets the accessibility role for the chart zoom toolkit.
member.value: Accepts a string that defines the accessibility role for the chart zoom toolkit. The default value is null.
member.remarks: Use this property to provide an accessibility role for the chart zoom toolkit.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to configure the accessibility role for the toolbar items in a chart's zoom settings. <SfChart> <ChartZoomSettings ToolbarDisplayMode="ToolbarMode.Always" AccessibilityRole="button" /> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@Data" Name="England" XName="XValue" YName="YValue"> <ChartMarker Visible="true" Width="10" Height="10" /> </ChartSeries> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartZoomSettings.Focusable
member.summary: Gets or sets the accessibility keyboard navigation options for the chart zoom toolkit.
member.value: Accepts the boolean value to enable or disable the keyboard navigation for the chart zoom toolkit. The default value is true.
member.remarks: Use this property to toggle the keyboard navigation focus for the chart zoom toolkit.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to configure zoom settings to be focusable in the chart. <SfChart> <ChartZoomSettings ToolbarDisplayMode="ToolbarMode.Always" Focusable="true" /> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@Data" Name="England" XName="XValue" YName="YValue"> <ChartMarker Visible="true" Width="10" Height="10" /> </ChartSeries> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartZoomSettings.ToolbarPosition
member.summary: Gets or sets the position of the zoom toolbar.
member.value: The position of the zoom toolbar, represented by a value. The default value is determined by the chart's default settings.
member.remarks: This property allows you to customize the position of the zoom toolbar in the chart. Changing this value will update the toolbar's position when the chart is rendered or updated.

member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartZoomToolbarPosition
member.summary: Provides the options for customizing the toolbar position in the Chart.
member.value: Accepts the instance of class. The default value is instance of .

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartZoomToolbarPosition.HorizontalAlign
member.summary: Gets or sets the horizontal alignment of the toolbar.
member.value:
Specifies the horizontal position of the toolbar. The available options are:
Left Aligns the toolbar to the left side of the chart.
Center Centers the toolbar horizontally within the chart.
Right Aligns the toolbar to the right side of the chart. This is the default value.

example.code: <SfChart> <ChartZoomSettings ToolbarDisplayMode="ToolbarMode.Always" Mode="ZoomMode.X"> <ChartZoomToolbarPosition HorizontalAlign="HorizontalAlign.Left"> </ChartZoomToolbarPosition> </ChartZoomSettings> </SfChart>

member.remarks: This property determines the horizontal placement of the toolbar relative to the chart's plotting area.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartZoomToolbarPosition.VerticalAlign
member.summary: Gets or sets the vertical alignment of the toolbar.
member.value:
Specifies the vertical position of the toolbar. The available options are:
Top Positions the toolbar at the top of the chart. This is the default value.
Middle Vertically centers the toolbar within the chart.
Bottom Positions the toolbar at the bottom of the chart.

example.code: <SfChart> <ChartZoomSettings ToolbarDisplayMode="ToolbarMode.Always" Mode="ZoomMode.X"> <ChartZoomToolbarPosition VerticalAlign="VerticalAlign.Top"> </ChartZoomToolbarPosition> </ChartZoomSettings> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartZoomToolbarPosition.X
member.summary: Gets or sets the horizontal offset of the toolbar from its horizontal position.
member.value: A double value that specifies the horizontal distance, in pixels, from the toolbar's horizontal position. For example, if the horizontal alignment is set to Center and the offset is 30, the toolbar will shift 30 pixels to the right of the center. Negative values move the toolbar in the opposite direction. The default value is 0.

example.code: <SfChart> <ChartZoomSettings ToolbarDisplayMode="ToolbarMode.Always" Mode="ZoomMode.X"> <ChartZoomToolbarPosition X="30"> </ChartZoomToolbarPosition> </ChartZoomSettings> </SfChart>

member.remarks: Use this property to fine-tune the toolbar's horizontal placement beyond the predefined alignment options.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartZoomToolbarPosition.Y
member.summary: Gets or sets the vertical offset of the toolbar from its vertical position.

example.code: <SfChart> <ChartZoomSettings ToolbarDisplayMode="ToolbarMode.Always" Mode="ZoomMode.X"> <ChartZoomToolbarPosition Y="50"> </ChartZoomToolbarPosition> </ChartZoomSettings> </SfChart>

member.value: A double value that specifies the vertical distance, in pixels, from the toolbar's vertical position. For example, if the vertical alignment is set to Middle and the offset is 50, the toolbar will shift 50 pixels downward from the center. Negative values move the toolbar upward. The default value is 0.
member.remarks: Use this property to fine-tune the toolbar's vertical placement beyond the predefined alignment options.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartCrosshairSettings.SnapToData
member.summary: Enables or disables snapping of the horizontal crosshair to the nearest data point.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartCrosshairSettings.LineType
member.summary: Gets or sets the line type for the crosshair.
member.value:
One of the enumerations that specifies the type of the crosshair line. The options include: - None: Hides both vertical and horizontal crosshair lines. - Both: Shows both vertical and horizontal crosshair lines. - Vertical: Shows the vertical line. - Horizontal: Shows the horizontal line.
The default mode is LineType.Both.
member.remarks: This property determines how the crosshair line is displayed on the chart, allowing for customization based on user preferences.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to enable the crosshair in a Chart and display it as a vertical line. <SfChart> <ChartCrosshairSettings Enable="true" LineType="LineType.Vertical" /> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@Data" XName="XValue" YName="YValue"> </ChartSeries> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartTooltipTextStyle.FontWeight
member.summary: Gets or sets the font weight of the tooltip text.
member.value: A string representing the font weight for the tooltip text. The default font weight is determined by the chart's theme. By default, the theme is set to with a font weight of 400.
member.remarks: This property is used to customize the font weight of the tooltip text.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to customize the text font weight of a tooltip in a chart. <SfChart> <ChartTooltipSettings Enable="true"> <ChartTooltipTextStyle FontWeight="bold" /> </ChartTooltipSettings> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@Data" XName="XValue" YName="YValue"> <ChartMarker Visible="true" Width="10" Height="10" /> </ChartSeries> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartTooltipTextStyle.Color
member.summary: Gets or sets the font color of the tooltip text.
member.value: A string specifying the color of the tooltip text. The default font color is determined by the chart's theme. By default, the theme is set to with a font color of rgba(249, 250, 251, 1).
member.remarks: Accepts a valid CSS color string in hex or rgba format.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to customize the text color of a tooltip in a chart. <SfChart> <ChartTooltipSettings Enable="true"> <ChartTooltipTextStyle Color="green" /> </ChartTooltipSettings> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@Data" XName="XValue" YName="YValue"> <ChartMarker Visible="true" Width="10" Height="10" /> </ChartSeries> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>
